# GITEX & Exhibition Livestream Production UAE — Packages, Pricing & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

GITEX and exhibition livestream production in the UAE costs between AED 8,000 and AED 80,000, depending on how many exhibition days need live coverage, how many stages or booths are streamed simultaneously, and whether the package includes daily highlight edits alongside the live feed. Backyard Studio produces exhibition livestream coverage across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — for trade shows like GITEX Global, Cityscape Dubai, and The Big 5, treating livestream production as its own package rather than an add-on bolted onto general exhibition photography or video coverage.

---

Why Exhibition Livestream Is a Different Package to Exhibition Video Coverage

Exhibition video coverage — booth photography, floor b-roll, a wrap-up recap video — is built for content produced after the event closes. Exhibition livestream production is a different discipline entirely: it has to run reliably in real time, across multiple exhibition days, often from multiple stages or booths simultaneously, with the technical redundancy to handle a dropped connection without losing the broadcast. A general exhibition video package doesn't include a vision mixer, dual internet failover, or a dedicated livestream operator monitoring the feed throughout the day — which is why exhibition livestream needs its own scope and its own price, rather than being quoted as a line item inside a standard exhibition coverage proposal.

GITEX & Exhibition Livestream Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price Range (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Single-Day Booth Livestream | 8,000 – 14,000 | One stage/booth, single camera, live switching, primary + backup stream | | Multi-Day Exhibition Livestream (4–5 days) | 25,000 – 45,000 | Daily live coverage across the full exhibition run, one stage | | Multi-Stage Livestream Package | 35,000 – 60,000 | Simultaneous coverage of multiple stages or booths across the show | | Full Exhibition Presence Package | 50,000 – 80,000 | Multi-stage livestream, daily highlight edits, and same-day social cutdowns |

What's Included in Exhibition Livestream Production

- Pre-event technical planning, including venue connectivity checks and stage/booth layout review - On-site vision mixing and live camera switching throughout each streamed session - Primary and backup internet connections to protect against dropped feeds mid-broadcast - A dedicated livestream operator monitoring stream health for the full duration of each session - Live graphics and branding overlays integrated into the broadcast feed - Daily VOD archive of each streamed session, available within 24 hours - Optional same-day highlight edits pulled from the livestream footage for social distribution

The Booking Process

1. **Consultation** — Backyard Studio confirms the exhibition, number of days, stage count, and target streaming platform. 2. **Technical site check** — connectivity, power access, and camera positioning are reviewed at the venue or against the floor plan ahead of the event. 3. **Written proposal** — a locked-price proposal is issued covering days, stages, and deliverables. 4. **Live coverage** — the crew streams each session live with real-time switching, backup connectivity, and on-site monitoring throughout the exhibition. 5. **Daily archive** — each day's stream is archived and made available as VOD within 24 hours. 6. **Final delivery** — a full archive and any highlight edits are delivered within 3–5 working days after the exhibition closes.

GITEX & Exhibition Livestream Across UAE Cities

**Dubai:** Backyard Studio provides livestream production at DWTC for GITEX Global, Cityscape Dubai, and The Big 5, where multi-stage, multi-day livestream demand is highest in the UAE.

**Abu Dhabi:** Coverage extends to exhibitions and forums at ADNEC, including livestream support for government-linked events.

**Sharjah:** Backyard Studio livestreams exhibitions at Expo Centre Sharjah, a regular venue for trade and industry shows.

**Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain:** Exhibition livestream coverage extends across the Northern Emirates for trade and business forums hosted in each emirate.

Why UAE Exhibitors & Organisers Choose Backyard Studio

- **Livestream treated as its own production discipline**, with dedicated crew, redundancy, and monitoring rather than a single camera pointed at a stage. - **Dual internet failover on every stream**, protecting against the single biggest risk in live exhibition broadcasting — a dropped connection mid-session. - **Multi-stage capability**, able to run simultaneous livestreams across more than one booth or stage within the same exhibition. - **Written, locked-price proposals** that scale clearly by day count and stage count, making budget approval straightforward for exhibitors and organisers. - **Coverage across all seven emirates**, supporting exhibitions at DWTC, ADNEC, Expo Centre Sharjah, and venues across the Northern Emirates.

Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does GITEX livestream production cost?

GITEX and exhibition livestream production in the UAE typically costs between AED 8,000 for a single-day booth stream and AED 80,000 for a full multi-stage presence package across a multi-day show like GITEX Global, depending on stage count and whether daily highlight edits are included.

### What is the difference between exhibition video coverage and exhibition livestream?

Exhibition video coverage is produced for after-the-fact content — booth photography, b-roll, and a recap video. Exhibition livestream is a real-time broadcast requiring vision mixing, backup connectivity, and a dedicated operator monitoring the feed throughout each live session, and is quoted and crewed separately.

### Can you livestream multiple stages or booths at the same time?

Yes. Backyard Studio's multi-stage livestream package covers simultaneous coverage of more than one stage or booth within the same exhibition, each with its own crew and connectivity setup.

### What happens if the internet connection drops during a livestream?

Every Backyard Studio livestream package includes a primary and backup internet connection, so the broadcast can fail over automatically without losing the live feed if the primary connection drops.

### Do you provide a recording of each day's livestream?

Yes. Each streamed session is archived and made available as VOD within 24 hours, and a full archive of every day's coverage is delivered after the exhibition closes.

### How far in advance should we book exhibition livestream production?

Backyard Studio recommends booking at least three to four weeks in advance for exhibitions like GITEX, since stage access, connectivity checks, and crew scheduling need to be confirmed well ahead of a show with this scale of demand.

### Which platforms can you stream to?

Backyard Studio can stream to YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, and custom or client-provided streaming platforms, depending on where the organiser or exhibitor wants the live audience to watch.

### Can we get same-day highlight clips from the livestream for social media?

Yes, with the Full Exhibition Presence Package. Same-day highlight cutdowns are pulled from the day's livestream footage and delivered for social distribution while the exhibition is still running.

---

# Web App Development for UAE Businesses — Pricing, Process & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Web app development for UAE businesses typically costs between AED 5,000 and AED 150,000 or more, depending on whether the project is a simple brochure website, a full e-commerce store, or a custom web application such as a booking system, client portal, or internal dashboard. Backyard Studio Official has an in-house web development team building websites and web applications for businesses across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain. This isn't limited to clients who also book photography or video: any business looking to build a brand new website from scratch can work directly with the in-house team, with the option to add brand content from the same studio if needed.

---

What Is Web App Development, and How Is It Different from a Website?

A website is typically informational — pages describing a business, its services, and how to get in touch, often built on a content management system like WordPress. A web app goes further, involving logic and functionality beyond displaying content: a booking system that checks availability, a client portal that shows account-specific data, an internal dashboard, or an e-commerce store handling payments, inventory, and order tracking. In the UAE specifically, web app projects also need to account for local requirements that don't come up in every market — Arabic right-to-left (RTL) design for bilingual audiences, integration with UAE payment gateways such as Telr or Network International, and PDPL (UAE Personal Data Protection Law) compliance for how customer data is collected and stored.

Web App & Website Development Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price Range (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Starter Business Website (5–8 pages) | 5,000 – 10,000 | Responsive design, basic SEO setup, contact forms, mobile-friendly layout | | Professional Corporate Website | 10,000 – 20,000 | Custom design, blog/CMS integration, analytics, multi-page structure | | E-Commerce Website | 15,000 – 35,000 | Product catalogue, payment gateway integration, order and inventory management | | Custom Web Application | 25,000 – 60,000 | Booking systems, client portals, dashboards, custom logic and database | | Enterprise / Complex Web Platform | 60,000 – 150,000+ | Multi-region support, API integrations, SaaS-style functionality, full compliance |

Ongoing costs to budget for separately include hosting (roughly AED 300–1,200 per month during active development, less after launch for smaller sites), domain registration, SSL certificates, and annual maintenance, typically 15–20% of the original build cost per year.

What's Included in Web App & Website Development

- Discovery consultation to confirm whether a website, e-commerce store, or custom web app actually fits the brief - UX and structure planning before any design work begins - Responsive design tested across mobile, tablet, and desktop - Arabic RTL layout support for bilingual UAE audiences, where required - UAE payment gateway integration (Telr, Network International, PayTabs, or similar) for e-commerce and booking projects - Basic SEO setup, including page structure, meta data, and site speed optimisation - PDPL-aware data handling for forms, accounts, and customer information - Post-launch support and a clear maintenance plan

The Booking Process

1. **Consultation** — Backyard Studio Official reviews the business goal and confirms whether a website, e-commerce store, or custom web app is the right fit, rather than defaulting to the most expensive option. 2. **Scope and structure** — site architecture, page count, and any custom functionality are mapped out and agreed. 3. **Written proposal** — a locked-price proposal is issued covering design, development, integrations, and timeline. 4. **Design and build** — design is completed and approved before development begins, avoiding costly late-stage changes. 5. **Testing and review** — the site or app is tested across devices and browsers, with a review round before launch. 6. **Launch and handover** — the site goes live with a maintenance plan agreed, and training provided if the client will manage content themselves.

Web App & Website Development Across UAE Cities

**Dubai:** Backyard Studio Official builds websites and web apps for businesses across DIFC, Business Bay, and Dubai Internet City, often paired with brand photography and video from the same team.

**Abu Dhabi:** Coverage extends to corporates and government-linked entities around ADGM requiring bilingual, compliance-aware web platforms.

**Sharjah:** Backyard Studio Official builds websites for growing SME and retail businesses around Al Qasba.

**Ajman:** The team develops websites and simple web apps for businesses across Ajman.

**Ras Al Khaimah:** Web development coverage extends to RAKEZ-based companies needing a digital presence alongside their brand content.

**Fujairah:** Backyard Studio Official builds websites for hospitality and trading businesses along Fujairah's coastline.

**Umm Al Quwain:** Coverage includes website development for SME businesses across Umm Al Quwain.

Why UAE Businesses Choose Backyard Studio Official

- **An in-house web development team**, so building a brand new website doesn't require going through a third-party agency — any business can commission a new site directly, whether or not they also work with Backyard Studio Official on photography or video. - **One team for the site and the content that fills it, when needed** — photography, video, and web development from a single studio, so brand visuals and the platform they live on can be built together rather than stitched from two vendors. - **Honest scoping**, recommending a simpler website instead of a custom web app when that's genuinely what the budget and use case call for. - **UAE-specific requirements handled from the start**, including Arabic RTL layouts and local payment gateway integration, rather than retrofitted later at extra cost. - **Written, locked-price proposals** that make budget approval straightforward, with pricing published openly rather than hidden behind a sales call. - **2,400+ projects delivered across all seven UAE emirates since 2023**, with aerial and full content production capability available alongside every web project.

Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does web app development cost in the UAE?

Web app development for UAE businesses typically costs between AED 5,000 for a basic starter website and AED 150,000 or more for a complex, enterprise-level web platform. Most SMEs land in the AED 10,000–35,000 range for a professional website or e-commerce store, while custom web applications with booking or portal functionality typically run AED 25,000–60,000.

### What is the difference between a website and a custom web app?

A website is primarily informational, displaying content about a business. A custom web app includes functional logic — checking availability, processing payments, managing accounts, or displaying user-specific data — which requires more development time and a higher budget than a standard content-based website.

### Do I need Arabic language support on my website?

It depends on your audience. If you're targeting UAE nationals, government entities, or a broad regional market, Arabic RTL (right-to-left) support is worth building in from the start, since retrofitting it after launch typically costs significantly more than including it in the original build.

### How long does website or web app development take?

A starter business website typically takes two to four weeks from approved design to launch. A custom web application with booking systems or client portals typically takes six to twelve weeks depending on complexity and the number of integrations required.

### What ongoing costs should I budget for after launch?

Beyond the initial build, budget for hosting (typically under AED 500 per month for a small site, more for apps with heavy media or real-time features), domain renewal, SSL certificates, and annual maintenance, generally 15–20% of the original build cost per year.

### Can Backyard Studio Official also produce the photography and video for my website?

Yes. Since Backyard Studio Official is a production studio as well as a web development team, brand photography, product images, and video content can be produced alongside the website build, keeping the visual identity consistent across the platform.

### Do you build e-commerce websites?

Yes. Backyard Studio Official builds e-commerce websites with product catalogue management, UAE payment gateway integration, and order tracking, suited to UAE retail and D2C brands.

### Is it cheaper to use an offshore development team instead of a local UAE agency?

Offshore development is often 40–70% cheaper on an hourly basis than local Dubai agency rates, but it typically requires more detailed upfront specification and a clear local point of contact to manage UAE-specific requirements like compliance and payment integration effectively.

---

# Restaurant & Menu Photography and Video Production UAE — Pricing, Process & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Restaurant and menu photography and video production in the UAE costs between AED 3,000 and AED 30,000, depending on the number of dishes, whether video content is included, and whether the shoot is styled for delivery apps, social media, or a premium hospitality brand. Backyard Studio produces restaurant, menu, and food content across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — covering menu photography, delivery platform-optimised images for Talabat, Deliveroo, Noon Food, and Uber Eats, and restaurant video content for Instagram and TikTok. Every project includes a written proposal and food styling coordination, since how a dish is styled matters as much as the lighting and camera work.

---

What Is Restaurant & Menu Photography and Video Production?

Restaurant and menu photography and video production covers the visual content restaurants, cafes, and hospitality brands need across their menu, delivery platforms, website, and social channels — a category where styling, lighting, and consistency matter more than almost any other type of commercial photography, since the entire goal is making a dish look appetising and true to how it's actually served. This includes menu photography for printed and digital menus, delivery app-optimised photography formatted specifically for Talabat, Deliveroo, Noon Food, and Uber Eats listings, restaurant ambience and interior photography, and short-form video content covering food preparation, plating, and the dining experience for social media. Because a menu or delivery app listing is one of the most-viewed pieces of content a restaurant produces, this category has a disproportionate impact on conversion compared to its production cost.

Restaurant & Menu Photography and Video Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price Range (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Menu Photography (Up to 15 Dishes) | 3,000 – 5,500 | Styled shots, consistent lighting, basic retouching, print and web files | | Delivery App Photography Package | 4,000 – 7,000 | Platform-optimised images for Talabat, Deliveroo, Noon Food, Uber Eats | | Full Menu Photography + Video (20–30 Dishes) | 6,000 – 10,000 | Full menu photography plus short-form video content from the same session | | Restaurant Video Content Package | 6,500 – 12,000 | Ambience, plating, and preparation reels for Instagram and TikTok | | Premium Hotel / Multi-Outlet F&B Production | 15,000 – 30,000 | Multi-outlet coverage, styled photography and video, brand-consistent editing |

What's Included in Restaurant & Menu Photography and Video Production

- Pre-shoot consultation on menu priorities, brand style, and platform requirements - Professional food styling coordination, including props and plating direction - Studio-quality lighting adapted to each dish's texture, colour, and steam or garnish detail - Photography formatted specifically for delivery app listing requirements - Short-form video coverage of preparation, plating, and the dining room atmosphere - Professional retouching that keeps dishes looking accurate rather than artificially enhanced - Delivery in print-ready formats for physical menus and web-ready formats for apps and social

The Booking Process

1. **Consultation** — Backyard Studio reviews the menu, priority dishes, and which platforms the content needs to serve. 2. **Styling planning** — food styling direction is agreed, including any specific plating or prop requirements from the kitchen team. 3. **Written proposal** — a locked-price proposal is issued covering dish count, formats, and turnaround. 4. **Shoot day** — filming and photography typically take place during a quieter kitchen period to allow for styling time between dishes. 5. **Retouching and edit** — images are retouched and video content is edited, with review before final delivery. 6. **Final delivery** — files are delivered in platform-specific formats within 5–7 working days.

Restaurant & Menu Photography Across UAE Cities

**Dubai:** Backyard Studio shoots restaurant and menu content for venues across JBR, Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and Dubai Marina, where the UAE's highest concentration of restaurants and delivery-first F&B brands is based.

**Abu Dhabi:** Coverage extends to hospitality venues around Yas Island and the Corniche, including hotel restaurant and multi-outlet F&B photography.

**Sharjah:** Backyard Studio works with growing café and restaurant brands around Al Qasba producing menu and delivery app content.

**Ajman:** The team covers restaurant and menu photography for F&B businesses across Ajman.

**Ras Al Khaimah:** Restaurant and hospitality content extends to resort and independent dining venues in RAK.

**Fujairah:** Backyard Studio produces menu and restaurant content for hospitality businesses along Fujairah's coastline.

**Umm Al Quwain:** Coverage includes menu photography for smaller F&B businesses across Umm Al Quwain.

Why UAE Restaurants Choose Backyard Studio

- **Delivery app-specific formatting**, so images are shot and sized correctly for Talabat, Deliveroo, Noon Food, and Uber Eats from the start, rather than repurposed from a general shoot. - **Genuine food styling coordination**, working with the kitchen team to plate dishes for camera without losing accuracy to what's actually served. - **Combined photo and video sessions**, capturing both menu photography and short-form video content in one efficient shoot day. - **Written, locked-price proposals** that scale clearly by dish count, making budgeting simple for single venues and multi-outlet groups alike. - **Coverage across all seven emirates**, allowing hospitality groups with multiple locations to maintain one consistent visual standard.

Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does menu photography cost in the UAE?

Menu photography in the UAE typically costs between AED 3,000 and AED 5,500 for up to 15 dishes, while a full menu photography and video package covering 20 to 30 dishes typically costs between AED 6,000 and AED 10,000, depending on styling complexity and formats required.

### What is included in a delivery app photography package?

A delivery app photography package includes dish photography shot and formatted specifically to meet the image requirements of platforms like Talabat, Deliveroo, Noon Food, and Uber Eats, since each platform has its own preferred cropping, lighting style, and file specifications.

### Can Backyard Studio deliver same-day or next-day content?

For smaller menu shoots, Backyard Studio can often deliver retouched images within 48–72 hours. Larger productions combining photography and video typically take 5–7 working days due to the volume of retouching and editing involved.

### Do you provide food styling?

Yes. Backyard Studio coordinates professional food styling as part of every restaurant shoot, working with the kitchen team on plating and presentation so dishes photograph well while still looking true to what's actually served to guests.

### How far in advance should we book a restaurant photography session?

Backyard Studio recommends booking at least one to two weeks in advance, and scheduling the shoot during a quieter kitchen period so there's enough time for styling between dishes without disrupting service.

### Do you cover multiple restaurant locations in one booking?

Yes. Backyard Studio regularly covers multi-outlet F&B groups and hotel restaurant portfolios, scheduling efficient coverage across locations and applying one consistent visual and editing standard throughout.

### What formats do you deliver?

Backyard Studio delivers print-ready files for physical menus, web-optimised images for websites and delivery apps, and vertical video formats for Instagram Reels and TikTok.

### What is the difference between menu photography and restaurant video content?

Menu photography focuses on individually styled dish shots for printed and digital menus and delivery platforms. Restaurant video content covers short-form footage of food preparation, plating, and the dining atmosphere, built for social media engagement rather than a static menu listing.

# AI Avatar & Virtual Presenter Video Production UAE — Pricing, Process & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

AI avatar and virtual presenter video production in the UAE costs between AED 3,000 and AED 30,000, depending on whether it's a single avatar video, a multilingual content package, or a full custom avatar build with an ongoing content retainer. Backyard Studio produces AI avatar and virtual presenter content across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — for brands that need consistent, always-on spokesperson content in multiple languages without scheduling a new shoot for every video. This works especially well for the UAE's multilingual market, where the same message often needs to be delivered in English, Arabic, and other languages for different audience segments.

---

What Is an AI Avatar or Virtual Presenter?

An AI avatar, sometimes called a digital human or virtual presenter, is a synthetic on-screen presenter generated from either a stock avatar library or a custom likeness — often built from a short recording of a real spokesperson, such as a company founder — that can then deliver any script, in any language, without a new filming session. Once the avatar is built and approved, new videos can be produced by submitting an updated script rather than re-booking a presenter, a studio, and a crew each time. This makes AI avatars particularly useful for content that needs to be produced frequently or in several languages at once — product explainers, training modules, investor updates, customer support content, and social media spokesperson videos.

AI Avatar & Virtual Presenter Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price Range (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Single AI Avatar Video (Stock Avatar) | 3,000 – 6,000 | Scripted video using an existing avatar, single language, basic editing | | Multilingual Avatar Package (3+ languages) | 8,000 – 14,000 | Same script delivered across multiple languages from one avatar | | Custom Branded Avatar Build | 12,000 – 20,000 | Avatar created from a recorded likeness, approved for ongoing brand use | | Founder Digital Twin Package | 15,000 – 25,000 | Custom avatar of a founder or executive, reusable for ongoing content | | Full Avatar Content Retainer (Monthly) | 10,000 – 30,000 | Recurring avatar video production across multiple scripts and platforms |

What's Included in AI Avatar & Virtual Presenter Production

- Consultation on whether a stock avatar or a fully custom branded avatar fits the brief - Script development tailored to the avatar format and target platform - Avatar recording session where a custom likeness is required, typically a short one-time session - Multilingual script adaptation and delivery from the same avatar - Human-led editing, motion graphics, and branding applied around the avatar output - Quality review and correction of AI-generated speech and expression before final delivery - Guidance on where AI avatar content fits best versus where a real presenter or live shoot is still the stronger choice

The Booking Process

1. **Consultation** — Backyard Studio reviews the use case and confirms whether AI avatar content, a hybrid approach, or a traditional shoot is the right fit. 2. **Avatar selection or build** — the brand chooses a stock avatar or commissions a custom avatar built from a recorded likeness. 3. **Written proposal** — a locked-price proposal is issued covering the avatar build (if applicable) and the number of videos or languages needed. 4. **Script and production** — scripts are developed and submitted for avatar generation, with human review at every stage. 5. **Edit and quality check** — Backyard Studio reviews the AI output for natural delivery, correcting any errors before branding and final edit. 6. **Final delivery** — videos are delivered in platform-ready formats, typically within days for standard scripts once an avatar is already built.

Where AI Avatars Work Well — and Where They Don't

- **Strong fit:** product explainers, recurring training content, investor and internal updates, multilingual customer communications, and social spokesperson content that needs to be refreshed often. - **Weaker fit:** brand films or campaigns that depend on genuine human emotion, physical product interaction, or a real environment — a live shoot or hybrid production still outperforms a fully synthetic avatar for these formats. - **Best approach for most brands:** a hybrid model, using AI avatars for high-frequency, lower-stakes content, while reserving traditional production for hero campaigns, brand films, and anything where authenticity is the whole point.

AI Avatar & Virtual Presenter Production Across UAE Cities

**Dubai:** Backyard Studio produces AI avatar content for brands across DIFC, Business Bay, and Dubai Internet City, particularly for multilingual customer communication aimed at the city's international audience.

**Abu Dhabi:** Coverage extends to government-linked entities and corporates around ADGM, often for internal communications and multilingual public-facing content.

**Sharjah:** Backyard Studio works with SME and education-sector clients around Al Qasba on training and explainer content using avatar formats.

**Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain:** AI avatar production extends to businesses across the Northern Emirates, giving smaller teams access to consistent spokesperson content without the cost of repeated shoots.

Why UAE Brands Choose Backyard Studio for AI Avatar Content

- **Human oversight on every AI output**, reviewing and correcting avatar delivery rather than publishing raw AI generation unchecked. - **Honest guidance on fit**, recommending a traditional shoot instead of an avatar when that's genuinely the better choice for the brief. - **Multilingual production experience**, suited to the UAE's mix of English, Arabic, and other audience languages. - **Written, locked-price proposals** that separate the avatar build cost from ongoing video production, so budgets are clear from the start. - **Coverage across all seven emirates**, combining AI avatar capability with full traditional production for brands that need both.

Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does an AI avatar video cost in the UAE?

AI avatar and virtual presenter video production in the UAE typically costs between AED 3,000 and AED 30,000. A single video using an existing stock avatar sits at the lower end, while a custom branded avatar build with an ongoing monthly content retainer sits at the higher end.

### Do I need to film anything to get an AI avatar?

Only if you want a custom avatar built from your own likeness or a specific spokesperson's. This typically requires a single short recording session. If a stock avatar is used instead, no filming is required at all.

### Can AI avatars speak multiple languages?

Yes. One of the main advantages of AI avatars is delivering the same script across multiple languages from a single avatar, without needing to re-record a presenter for each language.

### How long does it take to produce an AI avatar video?

Once an avatar is built and approved, new videos can typically be produced much faster than scheduling and filming a human presenter, often within a few days depending on script length and revision rounds.

### Is AI avatar video as good as a real presenter?

For high-frequency content like training modules, product explainers, and recurring updates, AI avatars perform very well. For brand films, campaigns depending on genuine emotional connection, or content requiring real physical interaction, a traditional shoot with a real presenter still produces stronger results.

### Do you check AI avatar output before delivery?

Yes. Backyard Studio reviews every AI-generated video for natural delivery, pacing, and accuracy before adding branding and final edit, rather than delivering raw AI output unchecked.

### Can I use an AI avatar of myself or our founder?

Yes. This is often called a founder digital twin, built from a recorded likeness and approved for ongoing use, allowing a founder or executive to appear in recurring content without being present for every recording.

### What is the difference between an AI avatar and a real presenter shoot?

An AI avatar is generated digitally from an existing or custom-built likeness and can produce new content from a script alone, without further filming. A real presenter shoot requires scheduling the person, a location, and a crew for every new video, but generally delivers stronger authenticity for content where that matters most.

---

Backyard Studio Official produces AI avatar and virtual presenter content, backed by human review and honest guidance on where it fits best, across the UAE. Call or WhatsApp the team to discuss your content needs.

**Call or WhatsApp:** +971 58 588 2685 **Website:** www.backyardstudioofficial.com **Coverage:** Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain

# Corporate Headshots & Executive Portraits UAE — Pricing, Process & Guide 2026

The right choice depends on who's being photographed and where the image will be used, and Backyard Studio scopes each project around that rather than a one-size-fits-all session.

---

Corporate Headshots vs Executive Portraits — What's the Difference?

Corporate headshots and executive portraits are related but serve different purposes. A corporate headshot is a consistent, efficient, head-and-shoulders image, typically produced for an entire team so every profile photo on the company website and LinkedIn matches in style, lighting, and background. An executive portrait is a more considered, higher-production session for senior leadership, board members, or founders, often shot with additional styling, multiple setups, and environmental or editorial-style compositions suited to press coverage, annual reports, and investor decks. Most UAE companies eventually need both: a fast, standardised headshot session for the wider team, and a more deliberate executive portrait sitting for the handful of people who'll represent the company publicly.

content:
# Dubai Filming Permit Fees & Fines 2026 — Why Backyard Studio Official Never Skips One

Quick Answer

Dubai filming permit fees start at AED 520 for the non-refundable Dubai Film and TV Commission (DFTC) application, plus location fees ranging from AED 0 to AED 25,000 per day depending on the venue. Filming without a permit is a serious offence, with fines reported as high as AED 25,000 for filming without a permit, AED 20,000 for violations like blocking pathways or unpermitted aerial filming, and documented cases of AED 50,000 fines plus a temporary UAE filming ban for unpermitted shoots. Backyard Studio Official applies for the correct filming permit on every commercial shoot across the UAE — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — as a non-negotiable part of how we work, because the permit fee isn't money that goes to us. It goes to the government body that regulates filming in the emirate, and skipping it puts the client's business at legal risk, not ours alone.

---

What Dubai Filming Permits Actually Cost (2026)

Every so often, a client asks whether we can just skip the permit for a small shoot — a quick product video in a public spot, a short reel filmed on a public beach, a "nobody will notice" location. They exist so that public spaces stay safe and usable, private property owners consent to being filmed on, and productions don't disrupt the public or damage a site. Respecting that isn't optional, and it isn't something we're willing to bend on to win a shoot.

**A fine is always more expensive than a permit.** Even the smallest location fee is a fraction of the fines on the table if a shoot is caught unpermitted — and beyond the fine itself, equipment can be confiscated and a shoot can be shut down mid-way, which costs far more in wasted production time than the permit ever would have.

**Our licence is on the line, not just yours.** Backyard Studio Official applies for permits under our own registration with the relevant authority. 1. **We confirm the shoot brief and locations** before anything is filed, so the application covers every day and site in one submission. 2. **We submit the script or shoot brief** to the relevant authority for review, which can take one to several weeks depending on the project. 3. **We handle location-specific approvals**, including Roads and Transport Authority sign-off for public roads, municipality approval for parks and beaches, or a No Objection Certificate from a private property owner. 4. **We pay the application and location fees** upfront and pass them through transparently in your proposal, at cost. 5. **We keep a copy of the approved permit on set**, since authorities can and do check during a shoot.

Filming Permit Compliance Across the UAE

**Dubai:** All commercial filming is regulated by the Dubai Film and TV Commission, the single authority for permits and location coordination in the emirate.

**Abu Dhabi:** Commercial filming is regulated through the capital's own media and production authority, with a comparable permit and fee structure.

**Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain:** Each emirate has its own filming approval process, typically coordinated through the local government or tourism authority, and Backyard Studio Official manages the correct application in each one.

# DVC vs TVC — What's the Difference? Complete UAE Guide 2026

Quick Answer

DVC stands for Digital Video Content, and TVC stands for Television Commercial — the core difference is the platform each is built for. A DVC is produced for digital and social channels like Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok, is typically shorter and more flexible in format, and costs between AED 5,000 and AED 25,000 in the UAE. A TVC is produced to broadcast standard for television and cinema, requires stricter technical specifications, higher production value, and often a bigger cast and crew, costing between AED 20,000 and AED 100,000 or more. Backyard Studio produces both DVC and TVC content across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — and helps brands decide which format actually fits their campaign and media plan before recommending either one.

---

What Is a DVC?

DVC stands for Digital Video Content — video produced specifically for digital platforms rather than traditional broadcast. This includes Instagram Reels, YouTube ads, TikTok content, website hero videos, and paid social campaigns. DVCs are typically shorter, more flexible in aspect ratio (vertical, square, or horizontal depending on the platform), and can be produced and published faster than a TVC. Because digital platforms allow for multiple versions and rapid testing, DVCs are also often produced in several cutdowns or variations from a single shoot day, built to be tested and optimised based on performance data rather than aired once in a fixed slot.

What Is a TVC?

TVC stands for Television Commercial — a video produced to broadcast standard for airing on television networks, and increasingly cinema screens as well. TVCs must meet strict technical specifications set by broadcasters, including specific resolution, audio levels, and duration formats (typically 15, 30, or 60 seconds). Because a TVC is often the single piece of content representing a brand's biggest campaign of the year, production value, casting, and post-production are usually higher than a standard digital video, and the approval process is more formal, often involving multiple stakeholders and a media agency booking airtime around the final cut.

DVC vs TVC — Key Differences at a Glance

| Factor | DVC (Digital Video Content) | TVC (Television Commercial) | |---|---|---| | Primary Platform | Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, websites | Television networks, cinema screens | | Typical Length | 6 seconds to 3 minutes, flexible | Fixed formats: 15, 30, or 60 seconds | | Aspect Ratio | Vertical, square, or horizontal | Horizontal (16:9), broadcast standard | | Production Timeline | Days to 1–2 weeks | 3–6 weeks including approvals | | Approval Process | Often internal marketing sign-off | Formal, multi-stakeholder, broadcaster compliance | | Typical Budget in UAE | AED 5,000 – 25,000 | AED 20,000 – 100,000+ | | Testing & Iteration | Multiple versions common, easy to update | Fixed final cut, costly to revise once aired |

DVC & TVC Production Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price Range (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | DVC — Single Social Video | 5,000 – 9,000 | One concept, single-day shoot, platform-optimised edit | | DVC — Multi-Version Ad Package | 9,000 – 18,000 | Multiple hooks and cutdowns from one shoot for ad testing | | DVC — Brand Digital Campaign | 15,000 – 25,000 | Concept, casting, multi-platform deliverables | | TVC — Standard Commercial (30 sec) | 20,000 – 45,000 | Concept, cast, broadcast-standard shoot and post-production | | TVC — Full Campaign Production | 55,000 – 100,000+ | Multi-location, high-end casting, VFX, cinema and TV delivery formats |

How to Decide Between a DVC and a TVC

- **Where will the content actually run?** If the plan is Instagram, YouTube, or TikTok, a DVC is the right format from the start — a TVC's technical specs won't matter on those platforms. - **What's the campaign budget and timeline?** DVCs are faster and cheaper to produce, making them the practical choice for most UAE SMEs and regular campaign content. - **Is this a major, one-time brand moment?** Product launches, national campaigns, or Ramadan hero content often justify the higher production value and broadcast reach of a TVC. - **Do you need to test and iterate?** DVCs are built for ad testing with multiple hooks and variations; a TVC is a single, final, polished piece that airs as-is. - **Many brands need both.** A common approach is producing one TVC as the campaign's hero piece, then cutting multiple DVC versions from the same shoot day for digital distribution — which is more cost-efficient than producing them separately.

DVC & TVC Production Across UAE Cities

**Dubai:** Backyard Studio produces both DVC and TVC content for brands across DIFC, Business Bay, and Dubai Media City, where most UAE advertising and marketing decisions are made.

**Abu Dhabi:** Coverage extends to government and corporate campaigns requiring both broadcast TVC and digital DVC deliverables from the same production.

**Sharjah:** Backyard Studio produces DVC content for growing SME brands and TVC work for larger Sharjah-based companies expanding regionally.

**Ajman:** The team covers DVC production for retail and e-commerce businesses across Ajman.

**Ras Al Khaimah:** DVC and TVC production extends to RAK's tourism and industrial sectors.

**Fujairah:** Backyard Studio produces digital and broadcast content for businesses along Fujairah's coastline.

**Umm Al Quwain:** Coverage includes DVC content for SME businesses across Umm Al Quwain.

Why UAE Brands Choose Backyard Studio for DVC & TVC

- **Format guidance before production begins**, so brands don't spend a TVC budget on content that was always going to run on Instagram, or produce an under-specced DVC for a broadcast slot. - **One shoot day, multiple deliverables**, cutting DVC variations from the same production as a TVC hero piece to maximise budget efficiency. - **Broadcast-standard technical compliance** for TVC work, so final files meet network and cinema delivery specifications without rework. - **Written, locked-price proposals** that clearly separate DVC and TVC scope, so budget approval is straightforward. - **Coverage across all seven emirates**, producing both formats for brands regardless of where they're based in the UAE.

Frequently Asked Questions

### What does DVC stand for?

DVC stands for Digital Video Content — video produced specifically for digital and social platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok, rather than television broadcast.

### What does TVC stand for?

TVC stands for Television Commercial — video produced to broadcast standard for airing on television networks and, increasingly, cinema screens, meeting stricter technical and duration specifications than digital content.

### Is a DVC cheaper than a TVC?

Yes, generally. A DVC in the UAE typically costs between AED 5,000 and AED 25,000, while a TVC typically costs between AED 20,000 and AED 100,000 or more, reflecting the higher production value, casting, and broadcast compliance a TVC requires.

### Can the same video be used as both a DVC and a TVC?

Not directly, because the technical specifications differ — a TVC is cut to broadcast standard in fixed durations (15, 30, or 60 seconds) and 16:9 aspect ratio, while a DVC is often vertical or square and flexible in length. However, both can be produced from the same shoot day and concept, with separate edits for each format.

### Which one do I need for a social media campaign?

A DVC is the right choice for a social media campaign, since it's built for the aspect ratios, lengths, and testing approach that platforms like Instagram and TikTok require.

### Which one do I need for a TV or cinema campaign?

A TVC is required for television or cinema advertising, since broadcasters and cinema chains have strict technical delivery specifications that a standard digital video won't meet.

### How long does TVC production take compared to DVC production?

A DVC can often be produced and delivered within days to two weeks, while a TVC typically takes three to six weeks, accounting for the more formal approval process, broadcast compliance checks, and higher production complexity.

### Do I need a bigger budget for a TVC than a DVC?

Yes, in almost all cases. TVCs generally require a bigger budget due to broadcast-standard production quality, formal casting, and the technical post-production work needed to meet network delivery specifications, while DVCs are built to be produced efficiently and often in multiple versions within a smaller budget.

# Best Video Production Company in UAE — Complete Guide & Checklist 2026

Quick Answer

The best video production company in the UAE is the one that matches your specific project — corporate video, events, e-commerce, real estate, or brand film — with in-house crew and equipment rather than outsourced freelancers, a written proposal with locked pricing before filming, and genuine coverage across the emirate where your business operates. Rather than asking who's "best" in the abstract, the more useful question is which company can actually deliver your specific brief, on budget, in your city.

---

What Makes a Video Production Company "The Best" in the UAE?

The UAE has one of the most competitive video production markets in the region, with dozens of agencies in Dubai alone claiming to be the top choice. Because "best" isn't a certified title — there's no single governing body that ranks production companies — the more useful approach is a checklist of concrete factors that separate a genuinely capable studio from one that outsources most of the work. This includes whether the crew and equipment are in-house or subcontracted, whether pricing is agreed in writing before filming starts, whether the company actually covers your emirate or just lists it on a website, and whether their past work matches the specific type of video you need rather than a generic showreel.

Typical Video Production Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Service Type | Price Range (AED) | What Affects the Cost | |---|---|---| | Corporate Video | 8,000 – 35,000 | Length, number of interviews, motion graphics, locations | | Event Videography | 6,000 – 30,000 | Event duration, number of cameras, same-day edit requirement | | Brand Film / TVC | 20,000 – 80,000+ | Concept complexity, cast, CGI or VFX, multi-day shoots | | Social Media / UGC Content | 4,000 – 20,000 | Number of videos, talent, ad-testing variations | | Real Estate / Off-Plan Video | 8,000 – 100,000+ | CGI requirement, drone coverage, number of units or master plan scale |

A Checklist for Choosing the Best Video Production Company

- **In-house crew and equipment** — ask whether the camera operators, editors, and drone pilots are employed by the company or subcontracted per project, since this affects both quality control and accountability. - **Written proposals with locked pricing** — a company confident in its process will provide a proposal in writing before filming, not a verbal estimate that changes after the shoot. - **Genuine multi-emirate coverage** — many Dubai-based companies list all seven emirates on their website but rarely film outside Dubai; ask directly about recent projects in Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, or the Northern Emirates if that's where you need coverage. - **In-house drone capability** — a GCAA-licensed, in-house drone team means aerial footage is planned as part of the shoot day, not bolted on by a third party afterwards. - **Relevant portfolio, not just a general showreel** — a company that's produced content in your specific category (clinics, real estate, weddings, corporate) will understand the regulatory and practical details that matter for that niche. - **Clear turnaround expectations** — ask how many days between the shoot and first cut, and whether that changes during busy seasons like Ramadan or Q4 exhibition season.

Why UAE Businesses Choose Backyard Studio

- **In-house GCAA-licensed drone team**, meaning aerial coverage is built into the production plan rather than subcontracted separately. - **Written, locked-price proposals on every project**, so budget approval is straightforward and there are no surprises after the shoot. - **Genuine coverage across all seven emirates** — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — not just a website claim, with active projects across the country. - **Founder-level creative direction**, led by Fahad Iqbal, a UK-trained fashion graduate, bringing genuine styling and visual expertise to fashion, e-commerce, and brand content specifically, alongside a broader production team for corporate, events, and real estate work. - **A specialised content library across categories** — from aesthetic clinic content built around DHA advertising standards to off-plan real estate films combining CGI and drone, rather than a single generic service offering.

Video Production Coverage Across UAE Cities

**Dubai:** Backyard Studio is based in Dubai and covers the city's full range of production needs, from DIFC and Business Bay corporate content to Dubai Marina and JBR event and lifestyle filming.

**Abu Dhabi:** Coverage extends to the capital, including government and corporate work around ADGM and Yas Island.

**Sharjah:** Backyard Studio produces content for businesses across Sharjah's retail, education, and industrial sectors.

**Ajman:** The team covers SME and retail businesses across Ajman.

**Ras Al Khaimah:** Production coverage extends to RAK's growing tourism, real estate, and industrial sectors.

**Fujairah:** Backyard Studio covers businesses along Fujairah's coastline and free zone economy.

**Umm Al Quwain:** Coverage includes businesses in Umm Al Quwain, completing full seven-emirate coverage.

Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I know which video production company is best for my project?

The right company depends on your specific project type rather than a general reputation. Ask to see work specifically in your category — corporate, events, e-commerce, real estate, or brand film — and confirm whether the crew and equipment are in-house, since that affects both quality and reliability.

### How much does video production cost in the UAE?

Video production costs in the UAE vary widely by category, typically ranging from AED 4,000 for a small social content package to AED 100,000 or more for a full real estate or brand campaign with CGI and multi-day shooting. Getting a written, itemised proposal is the best way to compare companies fairly.

### Does Backyard Studio cover video production outside Dubai?

Yes. Backyard Studio produces content across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — with active projects in each, rather than listing coverage that isn't actually serviced.

### Do you provide drone footage as part of a standard package?

Backyard Studio operates an in-house, GCAA-licensed drone team, so aerial coverage can be planned as part of the original shoot day rather than arranged separately through a third party, where the location and project allow it.

### How far in advance should I book a video production company in the UAE?

For standard corporate or event bookings, two to three weeks is generally sufficient. For larger productions involving CGI, casting, or multi-location shoots, or for peak periods like GITEX season or Ramadan, four to six weeks is recommended.

### What should be included in a video production proposal?

A proper proposal should include the shoot scope, number of days and locations, crew size, deliverable formats, revision rounds, and a locked price. If a company won't put pricing in writing before the shoot, that's worth treating as a red flag.

### Is a bigger production company always the better choice?

Not necessarily. Larger agencies may have bigger crews and more overhead, but a smaller, specialised studio with the right in-house capability for your specific project — drone, CGI, fashion styling, or DHA-compliant medical content, for example — can often deliver better results at a more predictable cost.

### What is the difference between a video production company and a freelance videographer?

A video production company typically offers in-house crew, equipment, and a structured proposal and revision process, while a freelance videographer works solo or with an ad-hoc crew assembled per project. Companies generally offer more consistency and accountability, particularly for larger or recurring projects.

# Music Video Production UAE — Pricing, Process & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Music video production in the UAE costs between AED 20,000 and AED 100,000, depending on the number of locations, whether choreography or a narrative storyline is involved, and how much post-production, colour grading, and VFX the concept requires. Backyard Studio produces music videos across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — for independent artists, label-signed talent, and brand-commissioned music content, handling concept development, filming permits, and music licensing clearance as part of the production. Every project starts with a written proposal and a treatment outlining the visual concept before a single frame is shot.

---

What Is Music Video Production?

Music video production covers the concept, filming, and edit of a video built around a piece of music — a category that sits apart from other video work because the edit is cut to the track's rhythm and structure rather than a spoken script, and because the visual concept often needs to carry the story on its own. This includes performance-style videos filmed in a studio or on location, narrative music videos with a storyline and cast, choreography-led videos requiring dance direction and multiple takes, and hybrid videos combining performance shots with cinematic b-roll. In the UAE, where Dubai in particular has become a regional hub for independent and label-backed artists, music video production also comes with practical considerations most other video categories don't — location filming permits from the relevant media authority, drone clearance for aerial shots, and music licensing or composer clearance for the track itself.

Music Video Production Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price Range (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Performance Video (Single Location) | 20,000 – 30,000 | One location, single-day shoot, performance-style filming and edit | | Narrative Music Video | 32,000 – 50,000 | Storyline concept, cast, multiple locations, cinematic colour grade | | Choreography-Led Music Video | 35,000 – 55,000 | Dance direction, multiple takes, styled set, multi-camera coverage | | Multi-Location Cinematic Video | 55,000 – 80,000 | 2–3 locations, drone coverage, styling, full cinematic post-production | | Full Concept-to-Delivery Production | 75,000 – 100,000+ | Treatment development, casting, multi-day shoot, VFX and colour grading |

What's Included in a Music Video Production Package

- Concept and treatment development before filming, outlining the visual direction and shot list - Location scouting and filming permit coordination for public and private locations - Artist and talent direction, including styling coordination where needed - Choreography and multi-camera coverage for dance-led concepts - GCAA-compliant drone coverage for aerial and establishing shots - Colour grading, VFX, and edit cut precisely to the track's rhythm and structure - Guidance on music licensing and composer clearance where the track isn't the artist's own original work - Delivery in platform-ready formats for YouTube, Spotify Canvas, and social platforms

The Booking Process

1. **Consultation and treatment** — Backyard Studio meets the artist or label to develop a visual concept and treatment based on the track. 2. **Location and permit planning** — locations are scouted and any filming permits or drone clearances are arranged ahead of the shoot. 3. **Written proposal** — a locked-price proposal is issued covering concept, shoot days, and post-production scope. 4. **Shoot day(s)** — filming is scheduled around the treatment, with multi-camera coverage for performance and choreography sequences. 5. **Edit and colour grade** — the video is cut to the track, colour graded, and refined with VFX where the concept calls for it. 6. **Final delivery** — files are delivered in platform-ready formats within 2–3 weeks depending on the complexity of the concept.

Music Video Production Across UAE Cities

**Dubai:** Backyard Studio produces music videos across Dubai Marina, Al Quoz's industrial and warehouse district, Downtown Dubai, and the desert locations just outside the city, coordinating filming permits with the relevant Dubai media authority.

**Abu Dhabi:** Coverage extends to locations around Yas Island, Al Reem Island, and the Corniche, popular for both performance and narrative music video concepts.

**Sharjah:** Backyard Studio shoots music videos across Sharjah's cultural and heritage districts, offering a distinct visual backdrop from Dubai's skyline-driven locations.

**Ajman:** The team covers music video shoots across Ajman's coastline and urban locations.

**Ras Al Khaimah:** Music video production extends to RAK's mountain and desert landscapes, popular for cinematic, location-driven concepts.

**Fujairah:** Backyard Studio produces music videos along Fujairah's coastline and mountain backdrops on the UAE's east coast.

**Umm Al Quwain:** Coverage includes music video shoots in Umm Al Quwain, offering a quieter, less built-up alternative location within reach of Dubai.

Why UAE Artists & Labels Choose Backyard Studio

- **Concept-first process**, developing a full treatment before filming rather than shooting without a clear visual direction. - **Permit and drone clearance handled in-house**, so artists don't need to navigate location and aerial filming approvals separately. - **Fashion-trained styling direction**, led by founder Fahad Iqbal, a UK-trained fashion graduate, for artist looks that feel considered rather than thrown together. - **Written, locked-price proposals** before filming begins, so budgets are agreed upfront regardless of how the concept evolves. - **Coverage across all seven emirates**, giving artists access to a genuinely wide range of visual locations without switching production teams.

Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does a music video cost to produce in the UAE?

Music video production in the UAE typically costs between AED 20,000 and AED 100,000. A single-location performance video sits at the lower end, while a full concept-to-delivery production with multiple locations, casting, and VFX sits at the higher end.

### What is included in a music video production package?

A typical package includes concept and treatment development, location scouting and permits, filming with multi-camera coverage, colour grading and edit cut to the track, and delivery in formats ready for YouTube and social platforms.

### Can Backyard Studio deliver same-day or next-day content?

A full music video edit typically takes 2–3 weeks given the colour grading and rhythm-cut editing involved, though a rough cut for artist review can often be turned around within a few days of the shoot.

### Do you handle filming permits for public locations?

Yes. Backyard Studio coordinates filming permits with the relevant UAE media authority for public location shoots, which is required for most locations beyond private studios or venues.

### How far in advance should we book a music video shoot?

Backyard Studio recommends booking at least three to four weeks in advance, particularly for narrative or multi-location concepts that require casting, permit approval, and choreography rehearsal time.

### Do you handle music licensing or copyright clearance?

Backyard Studio can advise on music licensing and composer clearance where the track being used in the video isn't the artist's own original composition, though the artist or label is responsible for securing the underlying rights to the music itself.

### Can you provide drone footage for music videos?

Yes. Backyard Studio operates as a GCAA-licensed drone team and can capture aerial establishing shots and dynamic drone sequences, subject to location-specific no-fly restrictions and any additional permits required.

### What is the difference between a performance video and a narrative music video?

A performance video focuses on the artist singing or performing to camera, typically in one styled location. A narrative music video builds a storyline around the track, often with cast beyond the artist, multiple locations, and a more cinematic shot list designed to tell a story alongside the music.

# School & University Event and Yearbook Videography UAE — Pricing, Process & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Written proposals are provided to school administration before the academic year begins, with content structured to work alongside a school's existing yearbook print process.

---

What Is School & University Event and Yearbook Videography?

School and university event and yearbook videography covers the photography and video content schools and universities commission across an academic year — portrait and yearbook photo days, graduation and convocation ceremonies, annual day performances, sports day, and other milestone events. This differs from general event videography because it usually involves child safety and parental consent considerations, coordination with school administration rather than a single event organiser, and delivery formats built to support a printed yearbook alongside video content for parents and the school's own marketing. Many UAE schools work with a photography partner across the full academic calendar rather than booking event by event, so Backyard Studio structures pricing around both single-event bookings and full-year school partnerships.

| Package | Price Range (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Portrait & Yearbook Photo Day | 3,000 – 6,000 | Individual and class portraits, print-ready yearbook image set | | Graduation or Convocation Coverage | 5,000 – 10,000 | Two-camera coverage, edited highlight video, individual graduate photos | | Annual Day or Sports Day Coverage | 4,500 – 8,500 | Full-day event coverage, edited highlight reel, performance photography | | Yearbook Video Package | 6,000 – 12,000 | Compiled video yearbook covering the academic year's key moments and events | | Full Academic Year School Partnership | 15,000 – 25,000 | Portrait day, 3–4 major events, and a full video yearbook across one academic year |

Backyard Studio works within the school's existing parental consent process for photography and video, and coordinates directly with school administration on any specific requirements around student privacy before any filming takes place.

Backyard Studio delivers print-ready image files sized for yearbook printing, alongside horizontal 16:9 video for school websites and parent communication, and vertical cutdowns where a school wants to share highlights on social channels.

Event coverage is a single booking for one occasion, such as graduation or annual day. # Off-Plan Real Estate Project Launch Video Production UAE — CGI, Drone & Pricing Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Off-plan real estate project launch video production in the UAE costs between AED 30,000 and AED 100,000, depending on how much CGI animation is required, whether a show unit exists to film, and how many deliverable formats the campaign needs across social, sales gallery, and investor presentations. Backyard Studio produces off-plan launch films across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — combining GCAA-compliant drone footage of the site, architectural CGI where the building isn't yet built, and lifestyle live-action content that gives international buyers confidence to purchase without visiting in person. Every project starts with a written proposal and is produced with DLD and RERA marketing standards in mind.

---

What Is Off-Plan Project Launch Video Production?

Off-plan project launch video production is the specific type of real estate content built to sell a development before it exists — a fundamentally different brief to filming a completed, move-in-ready property. Since there's often nothing physical to point a camera at beyond a construction site and a show unit, off-plan films typically combine architectural CGI flythroughs of the finished building, drone footage of the actual plot and its surrounding context, and live-action lifestyle sequences filmed in a show unit or comparable finished space. Because a significant share of Dubai's off-plan buyers are purchasing from overseas without visiting the site, the film has to do the work a physical viewing normally would — establishing scale, location, finish quality, and lifestyle in a way that removes doubt for a buyer committing millions of dirhams remotely.

Off-Plan Launch Video Production Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price Range (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Single-Unit Off-Plan Listing Video | 30,000 – 40,000 | Show unit walkthrough, drone context shots, basic CGI overlay, 1–2 minute edit | | Pre-Launch Teaser Package | 35,000 – 45,000 | Short teaser film using CGI renders and site drone footage ahead of official launch | | Master Development Launch Film | 45,000 – 65,000 | Full CGI flythrough, live-action lifestyle sequences, drone, 3–4 minute master edit | | Multi-Format Sales Gallery Package | 55,000 – 75,000 | Master film plus sales gallery screen edits, investor cut, and social cutdowns | | Full Developer Campaign (Launch to Handover) | 70,000 – 100,000+ | Pre-launch teaser, launch film, construction milestone updates, and completion film |

What's Included in an Off-Plan Launch Video Package

- Architectural CGI integration where the development isn't yet built, blended with live-action footage - GCAA-compliant drone coverage of the site, surrounding landmarks, and master plan scale - Show unit or comparable finished-space walkthrough where available - Lifestyle sequences with casting, styling, and direction suited to the target buyer profile - Motion graphics for unit types, floor plans, and payment plan information - Multiple deliverable formats: sales gallery screen loop, social cutdowns, and investor-facing edits - Multilingual voiceover or subtitle options for international buyer markets on request

The Booking Process

1. **Consultation** — Backyard Studio reviews the development, target buyer profile, and what's physically available to film versus what needs CGI. 2. **Concept and shot list** — a narrative structure is agreed, balancing CGI flythrough, drone context, and lifestyle live-action. 3. **Written proposal** — a locked-price proposal is issued covering CGI scope, shoot days, and every deliverable format. 4. **CGI and site filming** — CGI development runs in parallel with drone site filming and any live-action shoot days. 5. **Edit and integration** — CGI, drone, and live-action footage are combined into a single cohesive film with motion graphics. 6. **Final delivery** — files are delivered as a master edit plus sales gallery, social, and investor cutdowns, typically within 3–5 weeks depending on CGI complexity.

Off-Plan Launch Video Production Across UAE Cities

**Dubai:** Backyard Studio produces off-plan launch films for developments across Downtown Dubai, Dubai Hills, Business Bay, JVC, and Dubai Marina, where the highest volume of off-plan launches in the UAE takes place each quarter.

**Abu Dhabi:** Coverage extends to developments around Yas Island, Al Reem Island, and Saadiyat Island, producing launch content for the capital's growing off-plan market.

**Sharjah:** Backyard Studio produces launch films for developments around Al Qasba and Sharjah's expanding residential communities.

**Ajman:** The team covers off-plan launch content for developments across Ajman's growing residential and waterfront projects.

**Ras Al Khaimah:** Launch video production extends to RAK's resort and residential developments, including projects tied to the emirate's growing tourism and investment appeal.

**Fujairah:** Backyard Studio produces off-plan content for coastal and residential developments along Fujairah's growing property market.

**Umm Al Quwain:** Coverage includes emerging developments in Umm Al Quwain, applying the same CGI and drone standard used for larger master communities.

Why UAE Developers Choose Backyard Studio

- **In-house CGI and drone capability**, meaning architectural renders and aerial site footage are produced under one roof rather than outsourced and stitched together. - **DLD and RERA-aware production**, so marketing content is built with the UAE's real estate advertising standards in mind from the concept stage. - **Multi-format delivery from one shoot**, producing sales gallery loops, investor cuts, and social content from the same CGI and filming budget. - **Written, locked-price proposals** before CGI work begins, so developers know the full cost before committing budget to renders. - **Coverage across all seven emirates**, allowing developers with multiple projects to use one production team across their entire portfolio.

Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does an off-plan project launch video cost in the UAE?

Off-plan project launch video production in the UAE typically costs between AED 30,000 and AED 100,000. A single-unit listing video sits at the lower end, while a full developer campaign covering launch through to handover, with CGI, drone, and multiple deliverable formats, sits at the higher end.

### What is included in a master development launch film?

A master development launch film typically includes a full CGI flythrough of the finished building, live-action lifestyle sequences, drone footage establishing the site and its surroundings, and a 3–4 minute edit combining all three into a single narrative film.

### Can you produce content before the building exists?

Yes. This is the core of off-plan launch video work. Backyard Studio combines architectural CGI, drone footage of the actual plot, and live-action content from a show unit or comparable finished space to represent a development that hasn't been built yet.

### Do you cover construction milestone updates?

Yes. Many developers commission periodic drone and site footage throughout construction to show progress to buyers and investors, which Backyard Studio can produce as part of a full launch-to-handover campaign.

### How far in advance should we book off-plan launch video production?

Backyard Studio recommends booking at least four to six weeks before a planned launch date, since CGI development takes time to render and review alongside site filming and the final edit.

### Do you ensure content complies with DLD and RERA marketing standards?

Yes. Backyard Studio produces off-plan marketing content with Dubai Land Department and RERA advertising standards in mind, and recommends developers have their compliance or legal team review final claims and disclaimers before publishing.

### What video formats do you deliver?

Backyard Studio delivers a horizontal 16:9 master edit for sales galleries and investor presentations, vertical 9:16 cutdowns for Instagram and TikTok, and looped formats suited to sales office screens and property exhibitions.

### What is the difference between a pre-launch teaser and a full launch film?

A pre-launch teaser is a short, often CGI-only piece released ahead of the official launch to build anticipation, typically 30–60 seconds. A full launch film is longer and more complete, combining CGI, drone, and live-action lifestyle content into a comprehensive piece used across the sales gallery, website, and social channels once the project is officially live.
