content:
Corporate Videography UAE — Pricing, Process & Booking Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Corporate videography in the UAE costs between AED 8,000 and AED 35,000 for most business video projects, depending on the type of video, number of shooting days, number of on-screen talents, and post-production complexity. Backyard Studio provides corporate videography across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — covering DVCs (direct video commercials), brand films, executive interviews, conference coverage, recruitment videos, and product launch films. Written proposals with locked pricing are issued before any production begins.

---

What Is Corporate Videography?

Corporate videography is the professional production of video content for business purposes — including brand films, direct video commercials (DVCs), executive interview series, internal communications, product launch videos, conference coverage, and investor presentation footage. Unlike commercial advertising aimed at broad consumer audiences, corporate videography is primarily produced for business audiences: clients, investors, employees, regulators, and partners.

In the UAE, where business relationships depend heavily on trust signals and first impressions, corporate video has become an essential part of how companies communicate their credibility. Backyard Studio has produced corporate videos for companies across multiple sectors including real estate, finance, healthcare, technology, FMCG, government, and professional services — at venues across all seven UAE emirates including DWTC, ADNEC, DIFC, and major hotel conference facilities.

---

Corporate Videography Pricing in the UAE (2026)

The following price ranges reflect current market rates for professional corporate videography in the UAE. All Backyard Studio quotes are confirmed in writing before production begins.

| Package | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Digital DVC / Social Commercial | 15,000 | Creative concept + script, 1 shoot day, professional talent, 30-sec hero ad, 15-sec cut-down, 9:16 + 16:9 + 1:1 delivery, 2 revision rounds | | Broadcast TVC | 45,000 | Full creative development, 2–3 shoot days, professional casting, location scouting, 30-sec TVC + cuts, Arabic + English versions, 3 revision rounds | | Premium Brand Film | 150,000+ | Multi-day UAE-wide production, full art direction, large cast + crew, VFX + motion graphics, original music, international delivery | | Conference / Event Video Coverage | 7,500 – 20,000+ | Full-day photo + videographer crew, highlight reel, same-day social assets, press photography package | | Testimonial / Executive Interview | 3,500 – 8,000 | 1–2 camera, professional lighting, 1–3 interviewees, edited 3–5 min video, 48-hour delivery | | Corporate Headshots | 1,500+ | Professional studio or on-location headshots, edited selects, same-day delivery option |

Factors that affect your final quote: - Number of shooting days and locations across the UAE - Number of on-screen talent (employees, executives, actors) - Scripting and concept development requirements - Drone or aerial footage requirements (subject to UAE General Civil Aviation Authority permit) - Turnaround speed required - Multi-language deliverables (English, Arabic, Urdu) - Number of output formats and aspect ratios

---

What's Included in Corporate Videography

A full corporate videography package from Backyard Studio covers:

Pre-production: - Initial brief and scope call with your internal team - Full written proposal with itemised deliverables and locked pricing - Script development or review (for scripted formats) - Shot list, location scouting, and logistics planning - Talent coordination and executive scheduling support

Production: - Professional camera crew (1–3 operators depending on scope) - Studio or on-location lighting setup - Directorial guidance for non-professional on-screen talent - Teleprompter for scripted presenter formats - drone unit if aerial footage is required

Post-production: - Edit assembly and structural cut review - Motion graphics, lower thirds, and title cards - Colour grading and professional audio mix - Voice-over recording if required - Final delivery in all required formats (16:9 for web/internal, 9:16 for social, broadcast specs if required)

---

Types of Corporate Video Backyard Studio Produces

Brand films and company profiles: A 3–5 minute film presenting your company's story, values, capabilities, and team. Used on website homepages, investor presentations, trade show screens, and LinkedIn company pages.

DVCs (Direct Video Commercials): Short-form videos (30–90 seconds) designed to drive a specific business action — a call, a form submission, a product enquiry. Higher production value than social content; often used in paid media campaigns across YouTube, LinkedIn, and OTT platforms.

Executive interview series: Professionally filmed conversations with C-suite and leadership teams. Used for thought leadership content, media press kits, and annual report supplements.

Conference and event coverage: Full documentation of corporate conferences, AGMs, awards ceremonies, and product launches — see Backyard Studio's dedicated event videography service.

Recruitment and employer branding videos: Films designed to attract talent — typically featuring office environments, team culture, and employee testimonials. Used on careers pages, LinkedIn, and recruitment platforms.

Training and internal communications: Scripted, segmented video content for employee onboarding, compliance training, or leadership communications. Formatted for LMS platforms or internal SharePoint/intranet distribution.

Product launch films: Cinematic product reveals combining studio product photography, live event footage, and narrative voice-over. Particularly effective for B2B product launches at trade shows including GITEX, The Big 5, and Cityscape Dubai.

---

How the Booking Process Works

Brief submission — Share your objective, timeline, audience, and how the footage will be used. Backyard Studio will ask scoping questions to ensure the proposal covers the full deliverable set. 2. Written proposal and pricing — Full scope, deliverables, and pricing confirmed in writing. No verbal estimates or variable pricing. 3. Pre-production planning — Script review, shot list confirmation, location logistics, executive scheduling, and any venue access coordination. 4. Production day(s) — Full professional crew on location or in studio. All equipment, lighting, and logistics managed by the Backyard Studio production team. 5. Post-production and review — First edit delivered for feedback. One round of revisions included as standard in all packages. 6. Final delivery — All video files delivered digitally in agreed formats. Raw footage archive available on request.

---

Corporate Videography Across UAE Cities and Venues

Backyard Studio operates across all seven UAE emirates for corporate video production:

Dubai: DIFC corporate offices, Business Bay, DWTC, Madinat Jumeirah, Atlantis The Palm, Downtown Dubai, JLT, Media City, Dubai Internet City, and all major hotel conference facilities including the Jumeirah, Marriott, and Hilton properties.

Abu Dhabi: ADNEC conference facilities, Yas Island, Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), Corniche-area corporate offices, Emirates Palace, The St. Regis, and government and institutional venues.

Sharjah: Expo Centre Sharjah, University City corporate campuses, Sharjah publishing and media district facilities.

Northern Emirates: Full coverage available across Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah (including Marjan Island resort properties), Fujairah (including port and industrial facilities), and Umm Al Quwain. Travel and accommodation costs apply for overnight multi-day productions in Northern Emirates.

Backyard Studio handles all UAE venue coordination, filming permit requirements, and location logistics — reducing the administrative burden on your internal team.

---

Why UAE Companies Choose Backyard Studio for Corporate Videography

Sector experience across UAE industries: Backyard Studio has produced corporate content for companies operating in real estate, financial services, healthcare, technology, FMCG, government, construction, and professional services. Understanding sector-specific communication norms — what an ADGM financial services firm needs versus what a Dubai tech startup needs — produces better creative output than a generalist approach.

All-inclusive written proposals: Every Backyard Studio engagement begins with a written proposal that itemises every deliverable and locks the price. No line items added after production. No unexpected revisions charges for standard scope.

Multi-language production capability: Backyard Studio produces corporate content in English, Arabic, and Urdu, with voice-over and on-screen presenters available for all three languages. Critical for UAE businesses communicating across the full market.

Drone operations: Aerial footage for corporate productions requiring location establishment shots or property overviews is handled with full UAE General Civil Aviation Authority commercial drone licensing. A legal requirement for commercial drone filming in the UAE.

Fast turnaround options: Standard corporate video turnaround is 7–14 business days post-production. Rush turnarounds for investor presentations, trade show deadlines, or board meeting materials can be arranged on request.

---

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does corporate videography cost in the UAE?

Corporate videography in the UAE is priced by format. A Digital DVC (social media commercial) with concept, shoot day, professional talent, and multi-format delivery is AED 15,000. A full broadcast TVC with 2–3 shoot days, casting, and Arabic + English versions is AED 45,000. Premium brand films start from AED 150,000. Full-day conference and event coverage starts from AED 7,500. Executive interview and testimonial videos start from AED 3,500. Corporate headshots start from AED 1,500.

What is the difference between corporate videography and a TVC?

A TVC (television commercial) is produced to broadcast standards for paid media placement — typically 15, 30, or 60 seconds, built for high-reach audience delivery via TV, YouTube pre-roll, or OTT platforms. Corporate videography is broader and encompasses any professionally produced video serving a business purpose, from internal training content to investor brand films. DVCs are sometimes called corporate TVCs but are typically produced for digital distribution rather than broadcast. Backyard Studio produces both formats, and the production process and pricing differ accordingly.

Can Backyard Studio produce corporate videos in Arabic?

Yes. Backyard Studio produces corporate video content in English, Arabic, and Urdu. Arabic-language productions include native-Arabic scriptwriting, Arabic-speaking on-screen presenters, and Arabic voice-over — not simply translated subtitles. For UAE government clients and Arabic-language market communications, native-language production is significantly more effective than English-with-subtitles formats.

How long does corporate videography take from brief to delivery?

From brief to final delivery, a standard corporate video project takes 3–5 weeks — 1 week for pre-production and scheduling, 1–2 shoot days, and 7–14 business days for post-production. Rush production timelines can be arranged for board presentations, investor events, or trade show deadlines. Turnaround commitment is confirmed in the written proposal before production begins.

Do you provide scripting for corporate videos?

Yes. Backyard Studio provides full script development services for all scripted formats — brand films, DVCs, training videos, and executive interviews. The scriptwriting process begins with a detailed brief on your messaging objectives, target audience, and preferred tone. All scripts are reviewed and approved by your team before production begins. If your internal team prefers to write the script, Backyard Studio can provide script review and formatting guidance at no additional cost.

Can you cover corporate events and conferences in Abu Dhabi?

Yes. Backyard Studio regularly covers corporate events at ADNEC, Yas Island venues, and government and institutional event spaces across Abu Dhabi. Production teams travel from Dubai with no additional travel charges for Abu Dhabi events. The team is familiar with Abu Dhabi corporate event protocols, media credentialing requirements, and ministerial forum logistics.

What video formats do you deliver for corporate content?

Final corporate videos are delivered in all formats required for their intended use — 16:9 (landscape) for websites, investor presentations, trade show screens, and YouTube; 9:16 (vertical) and 1:1 (square) for LinkedIn, Instagram, and social media distribution; broadcast specs (ProRes, specific codec requirements) for media agency delivery. All required output formats are confirmed in the written proposal before production begins.

Do you offer ongoing retainer packages for corporate video content?

Yes. Backyard Studio offers monthly and quarterly retainer packages for companies that require consistent corporate video output — executive interview series, social media content packs, or regular internal communications. Retainer pricing provides better per-video rates than single-project bookings and includes priority scheduling. Contact Backyard Studio to discuss retainer structures appropriate for your content volume.

---

Backyard Studio provides written proposals for corporate video productions across the UAE — from single executive interviews to multi-day conference coverage and full brand film productions.

Social Media Video Production UAE — Pricing, Process & Strategy Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Social media video production in the UAE starts from AED 2,500 for a half-day Starter shoot (3–4 Reels + 20–30 photos) and AED 5,500 for a full-day Growth content day (6–8 Reels + 50–80 photos, multiple looks). Monthly retainer packages start from AED 8,000 per month for two shoot days and 12–16 Reels per month. Backyard Studio produces social media video content across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — creating Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn content that is built natively for each platform's algorithm, aspect ratio, and audience behaviour. Monthly retainer packages and quarterly content calendars are available for brands requiring consistent social video output.

---

What Is Social Media Video Production?

Social media video production is the planned, professionally executed creation of short-form and long-form video content for distribution on social media platforms — primarily Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Snapchat. Unlike a corporate film or broadcast commercial, social media video is produced with platform-specific formats, pacing, hook structures, and aesthetic choices that determine whether the content performs organically or disappears.

In the UAE, where social media penetration is among the highest globally (over 99% internet penetration, with Instagram and TikTok particularly dominant), professional social video has become a core component of how brands acquire customers, attract talent, and communicate credibility. Backyard Studio produces social media video content for brands across multiple sectors — retail, F&B, real estate, hospitality, fashion, and professional services — from locations across all seven UAE emirates.

---

Social Media Video Production Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Starter (Half-Day) | 2,500 | 4 hours, 3–4 edited Reels/TikToks, 20–30 edited photos, stories + feed formats, 48-hour delivery | | Growth (Full-Day) | 5,500 | 8 hours, 6–8 edited Reels/TikToks, 50–80 edited photos, multiple looks, hashtag + caption strategy, 48-hour delivery | | Monthly Retainer | from 8,000/month | 2 shoot days/month, 12–16 Reels/TikToks, 100+ photo selects, content calendar, trending audio sourcing, 24-hour priority delivery | | Reels (per shoot day) | from 2,500 | Dedicated Reels production day — platform-native shooting and editing, vertical format, trending hooks | | Additional Shoot Day (retainer add-on) | 4,000 | Additional full-day shoot within a retainer month |

Factors that affect your final quote: - Number of platforms and aspect ratios required (9:16 for TikTok/Reels, 1:1 for feed, 16:9 for YouTube) - Location requirements (indoor studio, outdoor, client premises, branded environment) - On-screen talent (internal team, brand ambassador, or sourced creators) - Editing complexity (graphics, text animations, transitions, sound design) - Turnaround speed required — same-day delivery possible with advance scheduling - Arabic-language content requirements

---

What's Included in Social Media Video Production

Creative planning: - Platform-specific content brief covering hook structure, pacing, and call-to-action strategy - Shot list developed around platform algorithm best practices for 2026 - Caption and hashtag recommendations for each video delivered

Production: - Professional camera crew with social-optimised equipment (vertical and horizontal setups) - Natural light or portable studio lighting as appropriate for brand aesthetic - On-screen direction for founders, employees, and non-professional talent - Location scouting for UAE-based shoots — outdoor, restaurant, retail, or office environments

Post-production: - Edited short-form videos in all required aspect ratios (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) - On-brand text overlays, captions, and lower thirds - Trending audio integration (subject to licensing requirements) - Colour grading aligned with brand visual identity - Auto-captions / subtitle files (SRT) for accessibility and silent viewing

---

Platforms Backyard Studio Produces For

Instagram Reels: 7–90 second vertical videos (9:16) optimised for the Reels algorithm. Hook-first structure — the first 1.5 seconds determine whether the algorithm distributes the video. Backyard Studio's editing approach is built around current UAE Reels performance data.

TikTok: 15 second to 3 minute videos with high-energy pacing, trending audio, and natural creator-style presentation. For UAE brands, TikTok performs differently from global markets — content that resonates in the Gulf prioritises authenticity, humour, and behind-the-scenes access over polished advertising formats.

LinkedIn: 1–3 minute professional videos — executive commentary, thought leadership, product demonstrations, case study walk-throughs. LinkedIn video is the platform where production quality signals matter most — a polished, well-lit executive video communicates professionalism to a B2B audience in a way that informal creator content does not.

YouTube / YouTube Shorts: Both long-form brand content (5–15 minute brand films or educational content) and 60-second Shorts for algorithm discoverability. YouTube is the highest-intent search platform in the UAE for video — users searching "video production Dubai" or "photographer Abu Dhabi" are actively looking for a provider.

Snapchat: High usage among 18–34 year old UAE nationals and residents. Snapchat video ad creative differs significantly from Instagram — faster pacing, younger aesthetic. Backyard Studio produces Snapchat-specific ad creative for brands targeting UAE youth demographics.

---

How the Content Process Works

Content strategy call — Backyard Studio reviews your brand guidelines, current social performance, target audience, and platform objectives. A shoot brief is developed with themes, formats, and deliverable targets. 2. Shot list and schedule — A full shot list is developed for the shoot day, covering every video format and scene. Schedule is optimised to maximise the number of unique deliverables from a single shoot day. 3. Shoot day — Professional crew on location or in studio. Director guides all on-screen talent through each video format efficiently. All lighting, equipment, and art direction handled by the Backyard Studio team. 4. Social Media Video Production Across UAE Cities

Backyard Studio shoots social media content across the UAE at brand premises and at iconic UAE locations:

Dubai: Business Bay offices and rooftops, Dubai Frame, JBR beachfront, Gold Souk, DIFC, Bluewaters Island, Burj Khalifa area, Mall of the Emirates, and branded studio shoots at Media City and Dubai Internet City facilities.

Abu Dhabi: Corniche, Yas Island, Louvre Abu Dhabi area, Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque surrounds (location permit required), Qasr Al Watan, and client brand premises.

Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah: Available for brand content shoots — RAK's mountain and desert landscapes are particularly effective for lifestyle, travel, and automotive social content. The Bab Al Bahr resort area in RAK is a high-demand backdrop for lifestyle brands.

Across Northern Emirates: All seven UAE emirates covered for location-based social content. Travel costs included within Dubai; additional travel allowance applies for overnight shoots outside Dubai.

---

Why UAE Brands Choose Backyard Studio for Social Video

Platform-native production: Backyard Studio's editing team works within the current algorithm dynamics of each platform — not generic video editing practices. The hook structure, caption length, audio choice, and text overlay placement in each video are made with UAE platform performance data in mind.

Arabic-language content capability: Social media content in Arabic outperforms translated English content on Instagram and TikTok for UAE-national and Arab expat audiences. Backyard Studio produces fully native Arabic-language social content — not subtitled translations.

High volume from single shoot days: Backyard Studio's shoot day workflow is designed to maximise unique deliverable count. A well-planned full shoot day can produce 20–30 usable social videos — enough to sustain 3–4 weeks of daily posting without repeating content.

Brand consistency across markets: For brands operating across the UAE's multilingual market, Backyard Studio produces matched content sets in English and Arabic from a single production day — ensuring brand consistency across both language audiences.

Fast turnaround: Standard delivery is 5–7 business days. Same-day edit delivery (short highlight clips) can be arranged for product launch days, event coverage, or time-sensitive campaign content.

---

How much does social media video production cost in the UAE?

Social media video production in the UAE starts from AED 2,500 for a half-day Starter shoot producing 3–4 Reels and 20–30 photos, with 48-hour delivery. A full-day Growth content day is AED 5,500, delivering 6–8 Reels and 50–80 photo selects across multiple looks with same-day hashtag and caption strategy. Monthly retainer packages start from AED 8,000 per month for two shoot days and 12–16 Reels per month with priority 24-hour delivery.

How many videos can you produce in a single shoot day?

With proper pre-production planning — a detailed shot list and a clear brief — Backyard Studio typically produces 10–20 usable social videos from a single full shoot day. The range depends on how many distinct looks, messages, and formats are planned. Shoots that try to cover too many themes without planning tend to produce fewer usable outputs. Backyard Studio provides a shot list in advance that maps each planned video to the shoot schedule.

Do you produce Arabic social media content?

Yes. Backyard Studio produces fully native Arabic-language social content with Arabic-speaking on-screen presenters, native Arabic script, and right-to-left text formatting. Arabic-language Reels and TikToks consistently outperform translated English content among UAE national and Arab expat audiences. Arabic content production does not cost more than English content of equivalent scope.

Can I use trending audio in professionally produced social videos?

Trending audio use in commercial social content is subject to platform licensing rules. Commercially licensed audio from music libraries (Backyard Studio uses licensed libraries) is the correct approach for branded content — unlicensed trending audio on brand accounts can result in video removal or account flagging. For some content types (especially TikTok organic-style videos), Backyard Studio can guide you on audio strategy appropriate for each platform and content purpose.

How long does it take to receive finished social media videos?

Standard delivery is 5–7 business days from the shoot date. For same-day or next-day delivery — typically for launch day event coverage or time-sensitive campaign content — same-day editing is available when arranged in advance. Delivery timeline is confirmed in the written proposal before the shoot date.

Do you offer a monthly social media content retainer?

Yes. Backyard Studio offers monthly retainer packages for brands that require consistent social video output — typically 2 or 4 shoot days per month, producing 20–60 videos per month. Monthly retainers include content calendar planning, priority scheduling, and reduced per-video rates compared to one-off bookings. Some retainer packages include platform scheduling support. Contact Backyard Studio to discuss a retainer structure appropriate for your social media content volume.

Can you produce content for both Dubai and Abu Dhabi in the same day?

For brands with premises or brand locations in both Dubai and Abu Dhabi, a single shoot day can sometimes cover both locations — depending on the travel time between shoot sites and the number of setups required. More typically, Dubai and Abu Dhabi shoots are scheduled on separate days. Backyard Studio's production team travels to Abu Dhabi with no additional travel charge for shoots within Abu Dhabi city.

content:
Product Video Production UAE — Pricing, Process & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Product video production in the UAE costs between AED 5,000 and AED 25,000 for most commercial product video projects, depending on the product type, number of videos required, shooting environment (studio or location), motion graphics complexity, and post-production turnaround. Backyard Studio provides product video production across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — covering eCommerce product videos, product launch films, product demo videos, social media product content, and brand hero films for physical and digital products. Written proposals with locked pricing are confirmed before any production begins.

---

What Is Product Video Production?

Product video production is the professional filming and post-production of video content designed to demonstrate, showcase, or sell a physical or digital product. The format varies widely depending on the product category, distribution platform, and intended audience — from a 15-second Instagram Reel showing a skincare product in use, to a 3-minute cinematic launch film for a luxury watch, to a 60-second product demo video explaining how a B2B software platform works.

In the UAE, product video has become essential for brands competing on eCommerce platforms (Amazon UAE, Noon), social media shops (Instagram, TikTok Shop), and brand website product pages. UAE consumers, particularly in the Dubai market, have among the highest e-commerce spending rates in the Middle East, and video has consistently been shown to increase product page conversion rates significantly compared to photography-only listings.

Backyard Studio produces product video content for businesses across the UAE across categories including FMCG, beauty and skincare, electronics and tech, luxury goods, fashion and apparel, food and beverage, and industrial and B2B products.

---

Product Video Production Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Product Shoots (starting price) | from 1,800 | Studio product shoot, professional lighting, edited selects, multiple angles | | Social Media Product Pack | from 2,500/shoot day | Reels-format product videos, lifestyle context, all social aspect ratios, 48-hour delivery | | eCommerce Product Video (Amazon/Noon) | from 3,500 | 30–60 sec product demo, Amazon/Noon technical specs, white background + lifestyle cut | | Product Demo / Explainer Video | from 5,000 | Scripted product function demonstration, presenter or voice-over, branded motion graphics | | Product Launch Film | from 15,000 | Cinematic 2–3 min launch video, professional talent, licensed music, multi-format delivery | | DVC / Commercial for Products | 15,000 – 45,000 | Full production commercial, concept + script, casting, broadcast and digital delivery |

Factors that affect your final quote: - Product type and complexity (liquid products, electronics, luxury goods each require different studio setups) - Number of SKUs or product variants to be filmed - Shoot environment — controlled studio setup vs. lifestyle location shoot - Motion graphics and 3D animation integration - Talent requirements (product demonstrator, lifestyle model, hands-only styling) - Number of deliverable formats and platforms - Turnaround speed required

---

What's Included in Product Video Production

Pre-production: - Product brief call covering target audience, platform distribution, and conversion objective - Shot list development — product angles, usage demonstrations, lifestyle moments - Studio setup plan or location scouting - Prop and styling coordination - Written proposal with locked deliverables and pricing

Production: - Controlled studio lighting setup optimised for product category (diffused for beauty/skincare, hard light for metals and electronics) - Specialist product styling (surface, background, and prop selection) - Lifestyle or model talent when applicable - Multiple camera setups covering macro detail, product-in-use, and beauty shots

Post-production: - Edit with branded colour grade - Motion graphics — product name typography, features callouts, brand end card - Professional audio mix and licensed music - Format delivery: horizontal (16:9) for website and YouTube; vertical (9:16) for Reels, TikTok, and eCommerce mobile; square (1:1) for feed posts - Amazon and Noon technical specs compliance where applicable

---

Types of Product Videos Backyard Studio Produces

eCommerce product videos: 30–60 second videos designed for Amazon UAE, Noon, and brand DTC website product pages. These follow the functional-then-lifestyle structure: product on white or clean background, then in-use lifestyle context. The format is driven by platform technical requirements (Amazon recommends MP4, H.264, 1920×1080, minimum 30fps) and by the conversion data showing that product video increases purchase intent on UAE eCommerce platforms.

Social media product videos: Short-form vertical videos (9:16, 15–60 seconds) for Instagram Reels and TikTok, designed to drive product awareness and direct-to-consumer sales. Hook-driven structure — the product benefit or transformation is shown within the first 2 seconds. Lifestyle context, ASMR-style product shots, and before/after formats all outperform pure feature-listing in the UAE social market.

Product launch films: 2–3 minute cinematic films produced for a product's market entry — used on brand websites, at trade show screens, in press launch presentations, and as YouTube hero content. Launch films are produced at a higher production value than eCommerce or social videos, with professional talent, licensed music, and a narrative or aspirational emotional structure.

Product demo / explainer videos: Demonstration-led videos (60–180 seconds) walking the viewer through how a product works. Common for tech products, B2B software, kitchen appliances, healthcare devices, and any product where function requires explanation. Can be presenter-led, hands-only, or animated — depending on the product and audience.

Beauty and lifestyle product videos: Specialised production for skincare, cosmetics, hair care, supplements, and wellness products. These follow the application demonstration + lifestyle aspiration structure, with close-up macro detail shots to communicate texture and quality. Backyard Studio has produced product content for beauty brands distributed across Dubai's retail market including Carrefour, Lulu Hypermarket, and boutique Dubai Mall outlets.

Unboxing and packaging reveal videos: High-engagement format for luxury goods, subscription boxes, premium FMCG, and electronic products. The unboxing video is one of the most-searched product video formats on YouTube UAE, and is effective for brands wanting to communicate premium packaging quality as a brand signal.

---

How the Booking Process Works

Product brief — Share product details, target platform, and conversion objective. Send product samples or images for pre-shoot planning. 2. Studio or location setup plan — Backyard Studio's production team designs the shoot setup optimised for your product category. Shot list with every deliverable is confirmed in writing. 3. Written proposal — Full deliverable list, format specifications, and locked pricing. No estimates or variable pricing. 4. Shoot day — All product styling, lighting, and equipment handled by the Backyard Studio team. Products should arrive 24 hours before the shoot date for pre-shoot styling prep where applicable. 5. Post-production and delivery — Edited videos with graphics, music, and colour grade delivered in all required formats. First edit review within 5–7 business days of shoot. 6. Revisions and final delivery — One revision round included. Additional revisions available at hourly rate.

---

Product Video Production Across UAE Cities

Backyard Studio produces product video content at its studio facilities and at client-nominated locations across the UAE:

Dubai: Studio shoots in Dubai's production hub area, location shoots at branded retail environments, lifestyle shoots at JBR, Downtown Dubai, and private residence settings for lifestyle product brands.

Abu Dhabi: Location product shoots available across Abu Dhabi — the Corniche, Yas Island, and client-specified brand environments. Studio shoot capability available via partnership facilities in Abu Dhabi.

Sharjah and Northern Emirates: Product shoots available across all seven emirates for brands requiring UAE-specific location context. Industrial and B2B product demonstrations available at Sharjah's industrial area and Fujairah port facilities.

All product samples shipped from Northern Emirates addresses are received at Backyard Studio's Dubai studio. Return shipping and insurance for high-value product samples can be arranged on request.

---

Why UAE Brands Choose Backyard Studio for Product Videography

Product category experience: Backyard Studio has produced video content for products across beauty, skincare, electronics, luxury goods, food and beverage, fashion, industrial, and B2B software. Each category requires different lighting approaches, styling decisions, and editorial choices — experience in your specific product type produces better results than a generalist approach.

eCommerce platform compliance: Backyard Studio's product video team is familiar with the technical specifications required by Amazon UAE, Noon, and the major UAE eCommerce platforms — codec, resolution, aspect ratio, and content policy requirements. Videos are delivered pre-formatted to platform spec, eliminating post-submission rejections.

Studio and lifestyle in one booking: Many product categories require both a controlled studio setup (for clean, technical shots) and a lifestyle environment (for aspirational, in-use context). Backyard Studio schedules and delivers both within a single production engagement, reducing coordination costs and maintaining visual consistency between studio and lifestyle footage.

Arabic-language content for UAE market: Product video with Arabic language overlays, Arabic voice-over, and Arabic subtitle tracks performs significantly better on Noon, TikTok, and Instagram for Arab-consumer-targeted products. Backyard Studio produces Arabic-language product content natively — not translation overlays.

Fast turnaround for launch timelines: Product launch dates are typically fixed. Backyard Studio offers rush post-production turnarounds to meet launch deadlines confirmed in advance.

---

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does product video production cost in the UAE?

Product shoots in the UAE start from AED 1,800. Social media product Reels start from AED 2,500 per shoot day. eCommerce product videos formatted for Amazon UAE and Noon start from AED 3,500. Product demo and explainer videos start from AED 5,000. A cinematic product launch film with professional talent and multi-format delivery starts from AED 15,000. Full DVC and broadcast commercial production for products is priced from AED 15,000 (Digital DVC) to AED 45,000 (Broadcast TVC).

What is the difference between product videography and product photography?

Product photography produces still images optimised for eCommerce listings, catalogue pages, and print. Product videography produces video content — movement, demonstration, and narrative — that communicates product function and lifestyle context in ways static images cannot. Both are important; Backyard Studio offers combined product photography and videography packages from a single shoot day, which provides visual consistency and reduces total production cost.

Can you produce product videos for Amazon UAE listings?

Yes. Backyard Studio produces product videos that meet Amazon UAE's technical requirements — MP4 format, H.264 codec, 1920×1080 resolution, minimum 30fps, aspect ratio 16:9, maximum 9 minutes. Product videos for Amazon listings are typically 30–90 seconds and follow the functional demonstration format Amazon recommends for conversion optimisation. Videos are delivered pre-formatted to Amazon specs, ready for direct upload.

Do you shoot products in a studio or on location?

Backyard Studio shoots product videos both in controlled studio environments and at lifestyle locations, depending on the product category and brand aesthetic. Products that require technical clarity (electronics, beauty, food) typically perform best in studio. Products that require aspirational lifestyle context (fashion, fitness, travel goods, home décor) typically benefit from location shoots. Many product categories require both — studio for technical shots, location for lifestyle footage — which Backyard Studio delivers within a single production engagement.

Can you produce product videos in Arabic?

Yes. Arabic-language product videos — with Arabic voice-over, Arabic text overlays, and Arabic subtitle tracks — are produced as standard. For brands selling to UAE national and Arab expat consumers on Noon, Instagram, and TikTok, Arabic-language product content is significantly more effective than English-language content with subtitles. Arabic product video is produced at the same price as English-language video of equivalent scope.

How many products can be filmed in one day?

The number of products that can be filmed in a single day depends on product complexity, setup requirements, and the number of video formats per product. For simple products with a single studio setup and 1–2 video angles, 5–10 SKUs per day is achievable. For complex products requiring multiple setups, lifestyle talent, or detailed demonstration, 2–5 products per day is more realistic. Backyard Studio provides a per-day capacity estimate in the written proposal based on your specific product set.

Do you provide models or talent for product videos?

Yes. Backyard Studio coordinates on-screen talent — product demonstrators, lifestyle models, and hands-only talent — for product videos that require a human element. Talent rates are provided as a separate line item in the proposal. For beauty and skincare products, Backyard Studio can coordinate talent with specific skin tone or demographic requirements. All talent agreements are handled by the Backyard Studio production team.

What video formats do you deliver for product content?

Product videos are delivered in all formats required for the intended platforms: 16:9 (landscape) for Amazon, website product pages, and YouTube; 9:16 (vertical) for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Noon mobile; 1:1 (square) for Instagram feed posts and Facebook product ads. Format requirements are confirmed in the written proposal before the shoot.

content:
Music Video Production UAE — Pricing, Process & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Music video production in the UAE starts from AED 8,000 for independent artist productions and rises to AED 75,000 and above for large-scale cinematic productions involving multi-day shoots, professional cast, choreography, and high-end VFX. Backyard Studio produces music videos across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — covering genres from pop and hip-hop to Arabic music, R&B, Bollywood-crossover, and electronic. Creative direction, location scouting, permit coordination, talent, styling, and post-production are all handled in-house by the Backyard Studio team. Written production proposals with locked budgets are issued before any shoot begins.

---

What Is Music Video Production?

Music video production is the complete creative and technical process of conceptualising, shooting, and editing a visual film to accompany a music track. From a single-location performance video to a multi-location narrative film with a cast, costumes, set design, and VFX, the scope of music video production varies enormously based on the artist's vision, the song's concept, and the intended distribution platform.

In the UAE, the music video production industry has grown significantly alongside Dubai's emergence as a hub for Arabic, South Asian, and international music artists. Artists recording in UAE studios — from independent musicians based in Dubai to major label artists using the UAE as a filming location for international releases — need production partners who understand both the creative demands of music video storytelling and the practical realities of filming across UAE locations. Backyard Studio has produced music videos at locations across all seven UAE emirates, including desert landscapes, urban environments, luxury properties, and controlled studio setups.

---

Music Video Production Pricing in the UAE (2026)

Music video budgets depend primarily on the number of shooting days, location complexity, cast size, wardrobe and art direction requirements, and post-production VFX. All Backyard Studio music video quotes are confirmed in writing before production begins.

| Package | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Indie / Performance Video | 8,000 – 15,000 | 1 shoot day, single location, artist performance focus, basic styling, 3–5 min edited video, colour grade | | Narrative / Concept Video | 15,000 – 35,000 | 1–2 shoot days, concept development, 2–3 locations, supporting cast, 3–5 min narrative film | | Premium Cinematic Production | 35,000 – 75,000 | 2–3 shoot days, full creative direction, professional cast + extras, set design, choreography, advanced post + VFX | | Arabic / Regional Release | 15,000 – 40,000 | Arabic-language concept, culturally appropriate styling, UAE and regional location setups | | Digital Reels/Teaser Edit | from 2,500/shoot day | Short-form promotional cuts from music video footage for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts | | International Artist UAE Shoot | 40,000 – 100,000+ | Multi-day UAE production for visiting international artists, location permits, full crew and equipment |

Factors that affect your music video budget: - Number of shoot days and locations across the UAE - Cast: solo performance vs. supporting actors, dancers, extras - Set design, wardrobe, and styling requirements - Choreography direction - Drone footage (permit coordination included) - Special effects, colour effects, or VFX in post-production - Turnaround speed: standard 2–3 weeks post-production; rush available

---

What's Included in a Music Video Production

Pre-production: - Creative concept development based on song brief, mood, and artist references - Location scouting across UAE — desert, urban, studio, luxury villa, architectural - Full UAE location and filming permits coordinated by the production team - Casting and talent coordination (supporting actors, dancers, background cast) - Wardrobe, styling, and art direction planning - Shot list and storyboard creation - Written production proposal with full budget breakdown

Production: - Director and professional camera crew - Professional lighting and grip equipment - drone unit for aerial sequences - On-set styling and wardrobe management - Hair and makeup if required - Playback setup for artist lip-sync performance takes

Post-production: - Edit assembly from performance takes and narrative footage - Colour grading — cinematic grade matched to song mood and genre - Visual effects, text animations, or transitions as required - Colour effects and creative grade (moody, desaturated, warm, etc.) - Delivery in 16:9 (YouTube/streaming), 9:16 (TikTok/Reels), and 1:1 (Instagram feed) - Lyric video version available as add-on

---

Types of Music Videos Backyard Studio Produces

Performance videos: Artist-focused videos emphasising stage presence, authenticity, and visual identity. Common for hip-hop, R&B, and singer-songwriter artists. Typically one key location with thoughtful art direction — a transformed industrial space, rooftop, or studio environment.

Narrative / concept videos: Storytelling videos where the song concept is expressed through a short film narrative running parallel or intercut with performance footage. Higher production value, requires actors and location variety. Common for pop and Arabic pop artists.

Dance / choreography videos: Videos built around choreographed movement — performed by the artist alone or with a dance ensemble. Require a production team experienced in timing edits to movement, controlling background environments, and shooting multiple takes for choreography accuracy.

Cinematic / brand-level productions: High-budget productions approaching the visual quality of a short film or commercial. Set design, costume design, multiple shooting days, VFX, and large crew. Used by major label artists, regional stars, and brands using music as primary campaign content.

Lyric videos: Animated text and graphic-driven videos synchronised to the song lyrics. Lower production cost than live-action — typically AED 3,000–8,000 for a professional lyric video. An effective option for independent artists releasing singles at pace.

Behind-the-scenes / documentary content: Supporting content from the music video shoot day — BTS footage, artist interviews, making-of content for YouTube or social media. Typically shot alongside the main production at minimal additional cost.

---

Music Video Filming Locations Across the UAE

Backyard Studio scouts and coordinates filming permits for music video locations across all seven emirates:

Dubai: The iconic Dubai skyline (Downtown, DIFC), industrial chic locations (Al Quoz warehouses, Dubai Industrial City), luxury property exteriors, beachfront (JBR, Jumeirah), desert dunes south of the city, and licensed studio facilities at Dubai Studio City and Media City.

Abu Dhabi: Architectural locations around the Corniche, cultural backdrops near the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque area (permits required), Yas Island, desert access in the Al Ain direction, and government-grade shooting locations.

Ras Al Khaimah: Mountain backdrops, dramatic Hajar Mountain landscapes, and the Jebel Jais area — one of the UAE's most visually striking and under-used music video locations. Backyard Studio has coordinated music video shoots in RAK for artists seeking dramatic natural environments unavailable anywhere else in the Gulf.

Sharjah, Ajman, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain: Available for location-specific shoots. Fujairah's east coast beaches and Khor Fakkan harbour are particularly effective for artists wanting Gulf of Oman ocean backdrops.

All UAE location permits, security clearances, and authority approvals are handled by the Backyard Studio production management team.

---

Why Artists and Labels Choose Backyard Studio

Genre-aware creative direction: Backyard Studio's directing team has produced music videos across Arabic music, Bollywood crossover, hip-hop, pop, R&B, and electronic genres — each with distinct visual languages, performance styles, and editing rhythms. A music video director who only knows one genre will impose that genre's visual grammar onto a brief that requires something different.

UAE location expertise: After 2,400+ productions across all seven emirates, the Backyard Studio team knows which locations work for which visual outcomes, which require permits and how long they take to obtain, and how to navigate the UAE's filming regulations efficiently. This matters enormously on music video shoot days where losing a location costs the entire day's budget.

Drone operations: Aerial sequences — drone shots establishing a location or following an artist through a landscape — are among the most impactful images in a music video. Backyard Studio operates drone units on music video shoots with full General Civil Aviation Authority commercial licensing, meaning no legal risk for the artist or label, and no shot that has to be cut for compliance reasons.

Arabic-language production capability: For Arabic music artists, Backyard Studio produces music videos with full Arabic-language creative briefs, Arabic-speaking directors and crew, and cultural understanding of Arabic music video conventions and audience expectations.

Written proposals, locked budgets: Music video production is an environment where scope creep is common and budget overruns are frequent industry-wide. Backyard Studio confirms every deliverable and its cost in writing before shooting begins. The quote you receive is the invoice you pay.

---

Music video production in the UAE starts from AED 8,000 for an indie or performance video with a single location, one shoot day, and standard post-production. Narrative concept videos with multiple locations and supporting cast typically run AED 15,000–35,000. Full cinematic productions with multi-day shoots, professional cast, choreography, and VFX are priced from AED 35,000 to AED 75,000 and above. Rush turnarounds for single release dates can be arranged with advance notice. Timeline is confirmed in the written proposal.

Services include full production management — location permits, equipment, local crew, logistics, accommodation coordination, and drone operations — so visiting artists arrive to a fully prepared shoot day. International production packages start from AED 40,000 for a full crew and location day.

content:
TVC Production UAE — TV Commercial Costs, Process & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

TVC (television commercial) production in the UAE costs from AED 15,000 for a Digital Video Commercial (DVC) distributed on social and digital platforms, AED 45,000 for a full broadcast television commercial with professional casting and 2–3 shoot days, and AED 150,000 and above for premium brand campaign films for luxury, government, and enterprise clients. Backyard Studio produces TVCs and DVCs across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — covering the complete production process from creative concept and scriptwriting through shooting, post-production, Arabic and English versioning, and broadcast delivery. Written proposals with locked budgets are issued before any production begins.

---

What Is TVC Production?

A TVC (Television Commercial) is a professionally produced video advertisement designed for broadcast on television, streaming platforms, or digital paid media. In the UAE market, the distinction between a TVC, a DVC (Digital Video Commercial), and a brand film has blurred significantly — most commercial productions are now developed to serve multiple distribution channels simultaneously, from Dubai-based satellite TV channels (Dubai TV, MBC, Abu Dhabi TV, Zee Aflam) to YouTube pre-roll, Instagram and TikTok paid ads, cinema advertising, and out-of-home digital screens across UAE malls and airports.

Backyard Studio produces commercial video content for brands across the full distribution spectrum — from lean, high-impact digital DVCs designed for social media paid campaigns, to full broadcast TVCs with talent, location complexity, Arabic and English language versioning, and delivery to broadcast technical specifications required by UAE television channels.

---

TVC Production Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Digital DVC (Social & Online) | 15,000 | Creative concept + script, 1 shoot day, professional talent, 30-sec hero ad + 15-sec cut-down, 9:16 + 16:9 + 1:1 delivery, 2 revision rounds | | Broadcast TVC | 45,000 | Full creative development, 2–3 shoot days, professional casting, location scouting, 30-sec TVC + cuts, Arabic + English versions, broadcast spec delivery, 3 revision rounds | | Premium Brand Campaign Film | 150,000+ | Multi-day UAE-wide production, full art direction, large cast + crew, VFX + motion graphics, original music composition, international broadcast and digital delivery | | Ad Campaign Pack (3 ads) | 35,000 – 65,000 | 3 x 30-sec or 15-sec ads sharing one shoot day, consistent creative direction, multi-format delivery across all platforms | | Corporate TVC | 25,000 – 45,000 | Business-focused commercial for B2B products/services, professional presenters, scripted narrative, broadcast and digital delivery |

Key cost drivers for UAE TVC production: - Number of shoot days (1 day vs. 2–3 days changes the budget significantly) - Talent: internal spokespeople vs. professional actors from a casting agency - Location: single controlled location vs. multi-location UAE-wide shoot - Arabic language version: voiceover only (+AED 2,000–5,000) vs. full re-shoot with Arabic-speaking talent - VFX, animation, or motion graphics complexity - Music: library track (included) vs. original composition (+AED 5,000–20,000) - Broadcast delivery specifications (prores, broadcast-grade colour grading, audio loudness specs)

---

The UAE TVC Production Process

1. Brief and creative development The process begins with a full creative brief — your brand, target audience, message, tone, and mandatory content elements. Backyard Studio's creative team develops 2–3 concept directions with treatment documents outlining the visual approach, casting direction, and location strategy. The selected concept is developed into a full script and shot list.

2. Pre-production Pre-production covers everything that happens before cameras roll: casting (from agency rosters or internal talent), location scouting and permit coordination across the UAE, wardrobe and prop sourcing, set design where required, and logistics planning. UAE commercial shoots at key locations — Dubai Marina, DWTC, Abu Dhabi Corniche — require filming permits from the Dubai Film and TV Commission or Abu Dhabi Film Commission. Backyard Studio manages all permit applications as part of the standard production process.

3. Shoot day(s) A commercial-grade shoot includes a director, director of photography (DoP), camera crew, lighting and grip team, production assistant, and on-set post coordinator. Professional actors work from call sheets with scene-by-scene schedules. Backyard Studio operates drone units on set for aerial sequences included in the creative concept.

4. Post-production Post-production for a UAE TVC includes edit assembly, colour grading to broadcast standards, professional audio mix with music and sound design, motion graphics or lower third titles, Arabic and English subtitle/caption files, and final delivery in all required technical specifications. Two to three rounds of edit review are included depending on the package.

5. Broadcast delivery For UAE television broadcast, final files are delivered to the specifications required by each channel — typically ProRes 422 or H.264 at broadcast loudness standards (-23 LUFS for international broadcast, -14 for digital platforms). Backyard Studio is familiar with the technical requirements of Dubai TV, MBC, Abu Dhabi TV, and UAE digital OOH network specifications.

---

Types of Commercial Productions Backyard Studio Creates

Brand commercials: 30–60 second brand films telling a company's story or communicating a brand positioning. Used on television, YouTube, and in pre-roll advertising campaigns.

Product launch commercials: Purpose-built ads introducing a new product to the UAE market. Typically run across broadcast, digital, and paid social simultaneously on launch day.

Promotional / offer commercials: Short-form (10–15 second) ads communicating a specific promotional offer — Ramadan campaigns, National Day offers, product discounts. Produced quickly and efficiently for seasonal campaign calendars.

Government and institutional TVCs: Commercially produced public awareness campaigns, ministerial messaging videos, and government initiative films. Backyard Studio is experienced in the protocols, approval processes, and message sensitivities required for government-commissioned commercial content.

Arabic and English bilingual campaigns: Full creative and production delivery in both Arabic and English — different scripts, different talent, different cultural nuances — produced as two complete versions that share the same core creative direction. Essential for brands targeting both UAE national audiences and expatriate consumers simultaneously.

Automotive commercial shoots: High-end car commercial production — a specialist category requiring precision driving coordination, specialised mount equipment, and the ability to shoot in UAE desert, mountain, and urban environments in a single production. Car commercial production starts from AED 25,000.

Digital commercials (DVCs): Optimised for paid social and YouTube — shorter, hook-first formats (6-second pre-rolls, 15-second skippable ads, 30-second brand films). Produced to platform best practices for paid media performance, not broadcast conventions.

---

TVC Production Across UAE Emirates

Backyard Studio manages commercial shoots across all seven UAE emirates with full permit coordination:

Dubai: All Dubai filming permits coordinated via Dubai Film and TV Commission. Key commercial locations — Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, JBR, DWTC, DIFC, luxury hotels, shopping malls, and desert locations south of the city.

Abu Dhabi: Abu Dhabi commercial shoots coordinated via Abu Dhabi Film Commission (twofour54). Key locations: Corniche, Yas Island, ADNEC, Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque area (strict permit process), Louvre Abu Dhabi environs.

Sharjah: Expo Centre Sharjah, Sharjah arts district, industrial locations, and heritage areas. Sharjah has specific content guidelines for commercial shoots — Backyard Studio manages compliance as part of the production process.

Northern Emirates (RAK, Fujairah, Ajman, UAQ): Desert locations in RAK and Al Ain direction, mountain roads in the Hajar range, east coast beaches in Fujairah — all available for commercial shoots with appropriate permits. Northern Emirates locations are frequently used for automotive, travel, and lifestyle commercial productions.

---

Why UAE Brands Choose Backyard Studio for TVC Production

Arabic and English bilingual capability: Backyard Studio produces Arabic and English versions of commercial content with native Arabic-speaking directors, crew, and talent — not translated scripts overlaid with subtitles. This distinction matters for brands wanting commercial messaging to land authentically with UAE national and Arab expat audiences.

Full permit management: Commercial shoots across the UAE require filming permits from multiple authorities — Dubai Film and TV Commission, Abu Dhabi Film Commission, individual mall or venue permits, General Civil Aviation Authority drone permits, and road closure permits for automotive shots. Backyard Studio manages the entire permit process, preventing the shoot-day disruptions that derail productions managed by less experienced production companies.

DVC pricing transparency: Most UAE production companies provide TVC quotes that balloon from initial estimate to final invoice. Backyard Studio provides itemised written proposals before production begins — talent, crew, locations, post-production, and delivery are all line-itemed. The proposal price is the invoice price.

Drone operations: Aerial commercial sequences — product reveals from above, location establishment shots, automotive drone chases — are handled with full General Civil Aviation Authority licensing. No unlicensed drone use that creates post-production risk or legal exposure for your brand.

---

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a TVC cost in the UAE?

TVC production in the UAE is priced by format and scope. A Digital Video Commercial (DVC) distributed on social and digital platforms starts from AED 15,000, including concept, a 1-day shoot with professional talent, 30-second and 15-second edits, and multi-format delivery. A full broadcast TVC with 2–3 shoot days, professional casting, and Arabic + English versions is AED 45,000. Premium brand campaign films for luxury and enterprise clients start from AED 150,000.

What is the difference between a TVC and a DVC in the UAE?

A TVC (Television Commercial) is produced to broadcast technical standards — specific codec, resolution, aspect ratio, and audio loudness specifications required by UAE television channels. A DVC (Digital Video Commercial) is optimised for digital distribution — social media paid ads, YouTube pre-roll, and digital screens — without the broadcast delivery requirements. Many UAE productions now produce both formats simultaneously, with broadcast and digital versions delivered from the same shoot. In budget terms, a DVC starts from AED 15,000 while a broadcast TVC starts from AED 45,000 due to the additional shooting days, crew requirements, and technical delivery standards.

How long does TVC production take in the UAE?

A standard DVC production takes 3–4 weeks from brief to delivery: 1–2 weeks pre-production, 1 shoot day, and 1–2 weeks post-production. A full broadcast TVC takes 5–8 weeks: 2–3 weeks pre-production (casting, locations, permits), 2–3 shoot days, and 2–3 weeks post-production including broadcast delivery. Rush production timelines for Ramadan, National Day, or seasonal campaigns can be arranged with advance notice.

Do you produce Ramadan and National Day commercial campaigns?

Yes. Ramadan and UAE National Day are the two peak commercial production periods in the UAE. Backyard Studio plans Ramadan campaign production from October–November for brands with late January/February launch dates. National Day campaigns (2 December) are typically produced in September–October. Booking production slots at least 8–10 weeks before a seasonal campaign launch is strongly recommended, as crew and locations fill quickly during peak periods.

Can you produce a TVC in Arabic only?

Yes. Backyard Studio produces TVCs in Arabic only, English only, or bilingual Arabic + English versions. Arabic-only commercials are common for brands targeting UAE national and Gulf Arab audiences via Arabic-language satellite channels — MBC, Abu Dhabi TV, and Dubai TV — where Arabic-language content is the dominant viewer experience. Backyard Studio's Arabic production includes native Arabic scriptwriting, Arabic-speaking talent, and Arabic-speaking directors.

What TV channels can you deliver to in the UAE?

Backyard Studio delivers TVC broadcast files to the technical specifications of Dubai TV, MBC (including MBC1, MBC2, MBC3, MBC4, MBC Masr), Abu Dhabi TV, Zee Aflam, and other UAE and pan-Arab satellite channels. Digital files for YouTube, Meta, and OTT platforms are delivered to the respective platform technical specifications. All required delivery formats are confirmed in the production proposal before shooting begins.

Do you handle TV commercial permits in Dubai and Abu Dhabi?

Yes. Commercial filming permits in Dubai are issued by the Dubai Film and TV Commission (DFTC). Permits in Abu Dhabi are managed through the Abu Dhabi Film Commission (twofour54). Backyard Studio handles all permit applications as a standard part of the production management process, including location-specific permits for malls, hotels, and public spaces, and General Civil Aviation Authority drone permits for aerial sequences. Permit timelines vary by location and authority — planning 2–4 weeks for Dubai and Abu Dhabi permit approval is standard for complex multi-location shoots.

content:
Documentary Production UAE — Pricing, Process & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Documentary production in the UAE starts from AED 25,000 for a corporate or brand documentary (15–30 minutes, 2–3 shoot days) and rises to AED 150,000 and above for full-length broadcast-quality documentaries with extensive fieldwork, multiple interview subjects, archival research, and multi-platform delivery. Backyard Studio produces corporate documentaries, brand origin stories, success story films, biographical films, journey films, individual achievement profiles, and social impact documentaries across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain. Written production proposals with locked budgets are confirmed before production begins.

---

What Is Documentary Production?

A documentary film is a non-fiction video production that uses real people, real events, and real environments to tell a story — as opposed to scripted fiction. In a business and brand context, documentary production covers a wide range of formats: a 10-minute company origin story for a website; a 30-minute profile of a founder's journey from idea to IPO; a social impact film documenting a government initiative; a biographical film about a sports personality, entrepreneur, or cultural figure; or a full-length feature documentary for festival submission or streaming platform release.

In the UAE, documentary production has grown significantly as brands, government entities, and individuals recognise the power of authentic storytelling to build credibility, communicate values, and achieve reach on digital platforms. A well-produced documentary generates trust signals that no advertising campaign can replicate — because it shows rather than claims. Backyard Studio has produced documentary content for corporations, government departments, individual entrepreneurs, athletes, and cultural institutions across the UAE.

---

Documentary Production Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Format | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Corporate / Brand Documentary (10–20 min) | 25,000 – 50,000 | 2–3 shoot days, 3–6 interview subjects, b-roll across UAE locations, narration, full edit + colour grade | | Success Story / Journey Film (5–15 min) | 15,000 – 30,000 | 1–2 shoot days, individual or team focus, interview + observational footage, cinematic edit | | Biographical Film (individual profile) | 30,000 – 70,000 | Full individual profile — interviews, archival stills/footage, location recreation, 20–45 min deliverable | | Social Impact Documentary | 35,000 – 80,000 | Multi-shoot fieldwork, multiple community subjects, voiceover narrative, subtitles, broadcast/streaming delivery | | Full-Length Documentary (45–90 min) | 80,000 – 200,000+ | Extended research + pre-production, multiple shoot days, archival research, professional narrator, broadcast delivery | | Mini-Documentary / Brand Origin Film (3–8 min) | 12,000 – 25,000 | Compact cinematic short, 1 shoot day, 1–3 subjects, professional edit — ideal for website, social, and investor decks |

Factors that affect documentary production costs: - Duration of the finished film (10 minutes vs. 45 minutes = very different edit complexity) - Number of interview subjects and their geographic locations across the UAE - B-roll complexity: talking head interviews only vs. observational fieldwork + location coverage - Archival research and integration of historical materials (photos, footage, documents) - Narration or voice-over recording - Animation, infographics, or motion graphics for data or historical sequences - Subtitles and language versions (Arabic, English) - Distribution platform: internal use vs. broadcast submission vs. international festival delivery

---

Types of Documentaries Backyard Studio Produces

Corporate and brand documentaries: A 15–30 minute film telling the story of a company — its founding, its people, its values, and its impact. Used on corporate websites, investor pitch decks, internal all-hands meetings, and as foundational brand content. Particularly effective for companies with a compelling origin story, a family legacy, or a clear social mission.

Success story films: A focused film profile — typically 5–15 minutes — documenting an individual's or organisation's achievement. Common for entrepreneurs, athletes, executives, and organisations commemorating milestones. Combines a structured interview with observational footage of the subject in their working environment, complemented by locations that contextualise the story.

Journey films: A film documenting the process of building something over time — a startup's road to funding, an athlete's training journey to a major competition, a creative project from concept to completion. Journey films work particularly well as serialised YouTube content (episodic) or as a single-long-form documentary capping a defined period.

Biographical films: A film profile of an individual — a business leader, creative figure, athlete, scholar, or cultural personality. More extensive than a success story film, biographical productions require deeper research, multiple interview subjects (colleagues, family, collaborators), archival materials, and a longer production timeline. Backyard Studio has produced biographical films for UAE-based entrepreneurs and sports personalities.

Social impact documentaries: Films documenting the work of NGOs, government initiatives, humanitarian programmes, or community organisations. These are typically produced for donor reporting, government submissions, international conference screenings, or public awareness campaigns. Backyard Studio produces social impact documentaries in Arabic and English, and is experienced working within the sensitivity requirements of UAE government and humanitarian organisations.

Individual video portfolio / achievement profile: A short documentary profile (3–8 minutes) designed to document an individual's career achievements, skills, or story — used by professionals, athletes, artists, and academics as a high-credibility digital portfolio piece. Increasingly used on LinkedIn, personal websites, and speaker bureau profiles.

---

How the Documentary Production Process Works

1. Research and development Documentary production begins with a research phase: reviewing existing materials (articles, photos, videos, reports), conducting preliminary interviews with the subject(s), and identifying the key story arc and structural approach. Backyard Studio's development process produces a treatment document — a written outline of the film's narrative structure, interview subjects, key locations, and visual approach — before any filming begins.

2. Pre-production Pre-production covers interview scheduling and location confirmation, release forms and clearance for archive materials, permit applications for UAE filming locations, and equipment planning. For documentaries involving government officials, royalty adjacent subjects, or restricted access locations, Backyard Studio manages the coordination and clearance process.

3. Principal photography Documentary shoots are typically non-scripted but structured: interview sessions with key subjects using a pre-agreed question framework, observational (fly-on-the-wall) footage in the subject's working environment, location b-roll across UAE settings relevant to the story, and any reconstruction or illustrative footage the narrative requires.

4. Post-production Documentary post-production is the most time-intensive phase: assembling interview footage into a coherent narrative structure, selecting and integrating b-roll, creating motion graphic sequences for data or historical context, recording narration or voice-over, music supervision and licensing, colour grading, audio mix, and subtitling. A 20-minute corporate documentary typically requires 3–4 weeks of post-production.

5. Delivery Delivery formats depend on distribution: H.264 MP4 for web/streaming (website, YouTube, Vimeo); ProRes for broadcast submission; DCP for cinema screening; and multi-format social cuts (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) from key documentary sequences for promotional distribution.

---

Documentary Filming Across UAE Emirates

Backyard Studio conducts documentary fieldwork across all seven UAE emirates:

Dubai: Corporate headquarters in DIFC, Business Bay, and Dubai Media City; entrepreneurial environments in Dubai Internet City and Al Quoz creative district; government facility filming with appropriate clearances; iconic Dubai locations providing visual context for the UAE's contemporary story.

Abu Dhabi: Government and institutional documentary subjects — ministries, cultural institutions, and sovereign wealth-adjacent organisations — are predominantly Abu Dhabi-based. Backyard Studio is experienced in the protocols, clearance requirements, and production sensitivities of Abu Dhabi government filming.

Sharjah: Cultural and heritage documentary subjects — Sharjah's museums, cultural districts, and heritage areas. Also industrial and manufacturing documentary subjects at Sharjah's industrial zones.

Northern Emirates: Ras Al Khaimah's Jebel Jais, mountain communities, and heritage villages; Fujairah's east coast port and fishing communities; Ajman and Umm Al Quwain's traditional boat-building and coastal heritage sites — all compelling locations for documentaries exploring UAE identity, geography, and heritage beyond the Dubai narrative.

---

Why Organisations Choose Backyard Studio for Documentaries

Long-form storytelling experience: Producing a compelling 20-minute documentary is fundamentally different from producing a 30-second ad. The structural decisions — what to show first, how to build tension, how to pace an interview sequence, when to use silence — require a different creative discipline. Backyard Studio's directing team has structured and delivered long-form documentary content across corporate, biographical, and social impact categories.

Arabic-language documentary capability: UAE stories exist in Arabic and English, and many of the most compelling subjects — government officials, UAE national entrepreneurs, cultural figures, and heritage communities — tell their stories most authentically in Arabic. Backyard Studio conducts and directs documentary interviews in Arabic with native-speaking directors, without translation layers that reduce the authenticity of the subject's voice.

Sensitive subject handling: Documentaries in the UAE often involve individuals and institutions that require careful handling — government officials, business leaders, royal family-adjacent organisations, and culturally sensitive community subjects. Backyard Studio's production team understands the cultural, legal, and diplomatic considerations of documentary production in the UAE environment.

Multi-platform distribution strategy: Backyard Studio delivers documentary content in formats optimised for every intended distribution point — website, YouTube, Vimeo, broadcast submission, and festival screening — alongside short-form promotional cuts for social media. The documentary becomes a content ecosystem, not just a single film.

---

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does documentary production cost in the UAE?

Corporate and brand documentary production in the UAE starts from AED 25,000 for a 10–20 minute film with 2–3 shoot days and professional post-production. Success story and journey films start from AED 15,000. Full biographical films with extensive research and archival integration are priced from AED 30,000. Full-length broadcast documentaries (45–90 minutes) start from AED 80,000 and scale with production complexity. All Backyard Studio documentary proposals are confirmed in writing before production begins.

How long does documentary production take?

A 10–20 minute corporate documentary typically takes 6–10 weeks from brief to delivery: 1–2 weeks research and development, 1 week pre-production, 2–3 shoot days over 1–2 weeks, and 3–4 weeks post-production. A full-length documentary (45+ minutes) requires 12–24 weeks depending on the research depth, number of subjects, and complexity of the post-production process. Timelines are confirmed in the written production proposal.

Can you produce documentaries in Arabic?

Yes. Backyard Studio produces documentaries in Arabic, English, or bilingual Arabic + English formats. Arabic-language documentary interviews are conducted and directed by native Arabic-speaking directors. Arabic subtitles, narration, and voice-over are produced in-house. For documentary subjects who are UAE nationals, Arabic-language production allows subjects to speak in their natural voice — which significantly improves the authenticity and emotional impact of the film.

Do you produce biographical films for individuals?

Yes. Backyard Studio produces biographical films for individual entrepreneurs, athletes, executives, academics, and cultural figures. A standard biographical film profile is 15–30 minutes and covers the subject's background, journey, achievements, and impact. Shorter individual portfolio documentaries (3–8 minutes) are also available for professionals who need a high-quality digital career profile for LinkedIn, speaker bureaus, or personal websites.

Can a documentary be submitted to film festivals?

Yes. Backyard Studio delivers documentary files in DCP (Digital Cinema Package) format for film festival and cinema screening submission. Festival-quality post-production — including broadcast colour grading, professional audio mix, and subtitle integration — is included in full documentary packages. Backyard Studio can advise on UAE and international film festival submission calendars and technical requirements.

Do you produce success story and journey films for businesses?

Yes. Success story films and journey films are among the most effective formats for UAE businesses communicating credibility to investors, partners, and new clients. A well-produced 5–10 minute success story film showing a company's founding team, growth milestones, client impact, and UAE market positioning functions as a powerful sales and investor relations tool. Backyard Studio produces success story films starting from AED 15,000.

---
