Fashion Film & Brand Campaign Production UAE — Pricing & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Fashion film and brand campaign production in the UAE starts from AED 15,000 for a Digital DVC campaign and AED 45,000 for a full broadcast-quality brand campaign with professional casting, multiple UAE locations, and Arabic and English delivery. Backyard Studio produces fashion films, brand campaign videos, promotional brand shoots, and seasonal campaign content for fashion, retail, luxury, hospitality, and lifestyle brands across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain. All productions are managed from creative concept through delivery with written proposals and locked budgets.

---

What Is Fashion Film & Brand Campaign Production?

A fashion film is a cinematic short film — typically 60 seconds to 5 minutes — in which a fashion brand's collection, identity, or season is expressed through visual storytelling rather than conventional advertising. Unlike a product video or a lookbook shoot, a fashion film uses narrative, movement, location, and music to communicate the emotional world of a brand. In the UAE, where the fashion and luxury retail market is one of the most competitive in the world — Dubai Mall alone hosts over 1,200 retail brands — fashion film has become the primary vehicle through which fashion brands compete for cultural relevance beyond product.

Brand campaign production is the broader category covering all professionally produced video content that serves a brand's seasonal, thematic, or strategic campaign — from a single hero film to a suite of campaign assets (hero video + cut-downs + social formats + behind-the-scenes content). Backyard Studio produces fashion films and brand campaign video content for fashion designers, retail chains, luxury boutiques, F&B brands, lifestyle brands, and hospitality groups across the UAE.

---

Fashion Film & Brand Campaign Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Fashion Shoots (photography + video) | from 5,000 | Half-day shoot, 1 model, 1 location, edited stills + Reels-format video content | | Brand Reels Campaign Pack | from 2,500/shoot day | 3–5 fashion Reels per shoot day, styled product + lifestyle footage, social formats | | Digital DVC / Brand Campaign Film | 15,000 | Concept, 1 shoot day, model talent, 30-sec hero film + social cuts, multi-format delivery | | Full Brand Campaign Production | 45,000 | Full creative, 2–3 shoot days, professional casting, multiple UAE locations, broadcast + digital, Arabic + English | | Seasonal Campaign (Ramadan, National Day) | 20,000 – 40,000 | Campaign-specific creative, 1–2 shoot days, full suite of deliverables across formats and platforms | | Premium Brand Film | 150,000+ | Cinematic multi-day production, full art direction, original music, international delivery |

---

What's Included in a Brand Campaign Production

Creative development: - Campaign concept, mood board, and visual direction - Shot list and storyboard across all planned deliverables - Model and talent casting coordination - Wardrobe and styling direction (working with your stylist or Backyard Studio's network) - Location scouting and permit coordination across UAE

Production: - Director and professional camera crew - Studio or location shoot with professional lighting setup - On-set styling, hair, and makeup coordination - Drone coverage for aerial campaign sequences - Product and detail shooting alongside hero content

Post-production: - Edited hero campaign film with colour grade matched to brand palette - Cut-downs: 15-sec, 30-sec, 6-sec formats for paid media - Social formats: 9:16 for Reels/TikTok, 1:1 for feed, 16:9 for YouTube - Behind-the-scenes and making-of content from the shoot - Arabic and English language versions

---

Types of Fashion & Brand Content Backyard Studio Creates

Fashion films: Cinematic short films expressing a brand's season, collection, or identity. Shot at iconic UAE locations or in controlled studio environments. Used on brand websites, Instagram, and in high-end fashion editorial distribution.

Brand campaign videos: Campaign-specific video content supporting a seasonal or product launch campaign — hero video + cut-downs + social formats produced from a single shoot day. Coordinated with campaign photography for visual consistency.

Promotional brand shoots: Combined photo and video shoot days producing content for a brand's full digital presence — website, social media, paid advertising, and email marketing — from a single coordinated production.

Profile revamp content: For established brands refreshing their visual identity — a new hero video, new product content, and new lifestyle imagery that repositions the brand in the market. Backyard Studio has produced profile revamp content for UAE retail brands, hospitality groups, and professional services companies moving into new market segments.

Lookbook films: Video versions of fashion brand lookbooks — each collection piece or look presented as a short moving image sequence. Used on e-commerce product pages to increase conversion.

Runway and show coverage: Professional videography and photography of fashion shows, designer presentations, and collection launch events. Backyard Studio has covered fashion shows at Dubai Design District (d3), Expo City venues, and hotel ballroom settings across the UAE.

Behind-the-scenes and making-of content: Documentary content from shoots, design studios, and manufacturing processes — used for brand storytelling on Instagram and YouTube.

---

Brand Campaign Production Across UAE Emirates

Dubai: Dubai's fashion landscape — Dubai Design District (d3), The Dubai Mall, City Walk, Jumeirah boutiques, and the luxury hotels of Downtown — provides the UAE's richest backdrop for fashion and brand campaign production. Desert access south of Dubai adds dramatic natural environments to the location mix.

Abu Dhabi: Luxury hospitality backdrops (Emirates Palace, Louvre Abu Dhabi area), cultural architecture, and the pristine beaches of Saadiyat Island — increasingly used by luxury fashion brands for campaign shoots.

Ras Al Khaimah: Mountain landscapes, dramatic rock formations, and the Hajar mountain roads offer fashion brands environments unavailable anywhere else in the Gulf. RAK is a frequently underused but visually extraordinary location for fashion campaigns targeting premium and adventure aesthetic directions.

Sharjah and Northern Emirates: Heritage and cultural architecture in Sharjah, coastal environments in Fujairah, and the distinct light quality of the UAE's east coast provide fashion brands with visual contexts distinct from Dubai's urban commercial aesthetic.

---

Why UAE Fashion Brands Choose Backyard Studio

Platform-native creative approach: Backyard Studio's fashion campaign output is designed for how fashion content is actually consumed in 2026 — Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Pinterest — not repurposed from a brand film format that doesn't suit the algorithm. Visual hooks in the first frame, movement pacing optimised for short-form, and content structured for platform shareability.

Full fashion production capability: From model casting coordination to styling direction, set design to location scouting, Backyard Studio manages the complete fashion production process — not just the camera crew. This matters for brands that don't have an in-house production manager.

Arabic fashion content: For UAE national and Gulf Arab fashion audiences, Arabic-language fashion content — captions, voice-over, and product descriptions in Arabic — significantly outperforms English-only content. Backyard Studio produces Arabic-language fashion campaign content natively.

Same-day Reels delivery: For fashion brands releasing seasonal drops, launch-day social content is critical. Backyard Studio offers same-day Reels delivery — content from a morning shoot ready for posting by the same afternoon.

---

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does fashion film production cost in the UAE?

Fashion film production in the UAE starts from AED 2,500 for a Reels-format content day and AED 15,000 for a Digital DVC brand campaign film with concept, model talent, and full post-production. A full brand campaign production with 2–3 shoot days, professional casting, multiple UAE locations, and broadcast + digital delivery is AED 45,000. Premium cinematic brand films start from AED 150,000.

What is the difference between a fashion film and a fashion campaign video?

A fashion film is a standalone cinematic short — typically 60 seconds to 5 minutes — produced primarily as a brand creative statement, often with artistic or narrative elements beyond straightforward product presentation. A fashion campaign video is production content serving a specific seasonal or product launch campaign — a hero video with cut-downs and social formats, coordinated with campaign photography. Most UAE brands need both: a brand film for their website and YouTube, and campaign videos tied to seasonal sales periods. Backyard Studio produces both from a single creative direction.

Can you produce fashion content for both Instagram and TikTok in the same shoot?

Yes. Backyard Studio's shoot days are planned to produce content simultaneously formatted for Instagram Reels (9:16, up to 90 seconds), TikTok (9:16, 15 seconds to 3 minutes), and Instagram feed (1:1 or 4:5). A well-planned full-day fashion shoot produces 6–12 unique platform-ready pieces of content across formats, providing a full month of social content from a single production day.

Do you work with models and stylists for fashion shoots?

Yes. Backyard Studio coordinates model casting, styling, hair, and makeup for fashion productions. The studio works with UAE-based model agencies and independent stylists, and can source talent that meets specific brief requirements — nationality, size, aesthetic, and experience level. All talent and styling costs are confirmed as line items in the written production proposal before the shoot date.

Can you handle Ramadan and National Day campaign shoots?

Yes. Ramadan and UAE National Day (2 December) are the UAE's two peak fashion campaign periods. Backyard Studio plans Ramadan campaign shoots from November onwards for February release, and National Day campaigns from September–October. The visual conventions, colour palettes, and messaging approaches for both campaigns are well understood by the Backyard Studio team. Booking production slots 8–10 weeks before a seasonal launch is recommended.

---

content:
Testimonial Video Production UAE — Pricing, Process & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Testimonial video production in the UAE starts from AED 3,500 per interview subject for a professional single-camera testimonial with lighting, edit, colour grade, and social format delivery. Multi-subject testimonial suites — four to six clients filmed in a single day at a conference, office, or event — are a cost-efficient format starting from AED 7,500 for the full day. Backyard Studio produces client testimonial videos, case study films, and success story interviews across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — for B2B companies, real estate brands, SaaS businesses, healthcare providers, hospitality groups, and professional services firms.

---

What Is Testimonial Video Production?

A testimonial video is a filmed interview in which a satisfied customer or client speaks directly to camera — or in conversation with an interviewer — about their experience with a product, service, or company. Testimonial videos are the most trusted form of marketing content in 2026: third-party validation from a named, credible client is more persuasive than any brand-produced advertising. In the UAE market, where business decisions are relationship-driven and referral-based, a well-produced client testimonial video functions simultaneously as social proof, sales content, case study, and brand credibility signal.

Beyond the standard talking-head format, Backyard Studio produces testimonial content across a spectrum of formats: a single-interview social clip, a full case study film featuring client interviews alongside project footage, a multi-client success story reel for a website homepage, and testimonial content captured at industry events and client summits where multiple clients can be filmed in a single day.

---

Testimonial Video Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Format | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Single Testimonial (1 subject) | from 3,500 | Half-day, 1 interview setup, lighting, edit, colour grade, social + web formats | | Multi-Testimonial Suite (4–6 subjects) | from 7,500 | Full day, multiple subjects on location or at office, edited individual clips + highlights reel | | Case Study Film (3–8 min) | 8,000 – 18,000 | Client interview + project footage + branded graphics, full case study edit | | Event Testimonial Day | from 7,500 | Same-day testimonial filming at conference or exhibition, 4–8 subjects, edited clips within 48 hours | | Success Story Campaign Pack | 15,000 – 25,000 | 3 × full case study films — matched creative direction, social cuts, website + paid media formats |

---

What's Included in a Testimonial Video Production

Pre-production: - Interview question guide developed for your industry and objective - Location or office setup — using your own space or Backyard Studio's network - Brief document for interview subjects — so they know what to expect

Production: - Professional lighting setup (two-point or three-point depending on space) - Dual-camera interview setup (wide shot + close-up) for editorial flexibility - Professional audio — lapel microphone and directional mic as backup - B-roll footage of your product, office, facilities, or event environment - Lower thirds and company branding in the edit

Post-production: - Edit — interview cut with b-roll integrated - Colour grade and audio levelling - Branded lower thirds: subject name, company, title - Music bed (licensed library track) - Delivery: 16:9 web version, 9:16 social version, 1:1 square for LinkedIn - Subtitle / caption file for social media

---

Types of Testimonial Content Backyard Studio Creates

Client interview testimonials: Single or multi-subject filmed interviews — structured around the customer's challenge, the solution Backyard Studio (or your company) provided, and the measurable outcome. This is the core format for sales pages, LinkedIn ads, and homepage video.

Case study films: Extended testimonial content (3–8 minutes) weaving client interview with project footage, before-and-after documentation, and branded motion graphics. Case study films work particularly well for professional services, real estate, construction, and technology companies where the outcome is visual or quantifiable.

Event testimonials: Testimonials captured at industry events — GITEX, Cityscape Dubai, Abu Dhabi Finance Week, The Big 5, DWTC exhibitions — while clients are gathered in a single location. A full-day event testimonial shoot can produce 6–10 individual client clips with 48-hour turnaround.

B2B sales testimonials: Specifically structured for B2B sales enablement — clients speak to quantifiable business outcomes (cost savings, time savings, revenue growth) rather than general satisfaction. Formatted for embedding in sales decks, LinkedIn InMail campaigns, and proposal follow-up emails.

Healthcare and professional testimonials: Patient testimonials, professional endorsements, and expert interviews for UAE healthcare, legal, and financial services brands. Produced with the sensitivity required for regulated industries.

---

Testimonial Video Production Across UAE Emirates

Dubai: Most B2B testimonial shoots are conducted at client offices in Business Bay, DIFC, JLT, and Dubai Media City. Conference testimonials are captured at DWTC, Dubai World Trade Centre, and major hotels across the city.

Abu Dhabi: Government and enterprise testimonials in Abu Dhabi — Ministry district offices, ADNEC, Yas Island venues. Backyard Studio travels to Abu Dhabi for testimonial shoots with no additional travel charge for most locations.

Sharjah and Northern Emirates: Available for all locations. Expo Centre Sharjah, Sharjah SAIF Zone, and RAK Free Trade Zone are regular locations for B2B testimonial shoots.

---

Why UAE Companies Choose Backyard Studio for Testimonials

The interview guide matters: Backyard Studio develops a structured interview question framework before each testimonial shoot — questions built around the client's industry, the specific outcome to highlight, and the sales objection the testimonial needs to address. A professional question guide is the difference between a compelling testimonial and a meandering client endorsement.

Dual-camera setup: Filming with two cameras simultaneously (wide shot + close-up) gives the editor flexibility to cut natural pauses and hesitations without jarring jump cuts. Single-camera testimonials cut poorly and look unprofessional. All Backyard Studio testimonial productions use dual-camera as standard.

Client comfort: Testimonial subjects are not professional speakers. Backyard Studio's interview approach — a structured pre-interview briefing, a natural conversational tone rather than a formal sit-down, and multiple takes — produces testimonial content where the subject sounds credible and human rather than rehearsed.

Same-day and 48-hour turnaround: For testimonials captured at conferences and exhibitions, Backyard Studio offers 48-hour turnaround on edited clips — so content can be posted while the event is still live and top-of-mind for the LinkedIn audience that attended.

---

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a testimonial video cost in the UAE?

Testimonial video production in the UAE starts from AED 3,500 for a single-subject interview with professional lighting, dual-camera setup, edit, colour grade, and multi-format delivery. A multi-testimonial suite with 4–6 subjects filmed in a full day starts from AED 7,500. A full case study film (3–8 minutes) combining interview with b-roll and branded graphics is AED 8,000–18,000.

How many testimonial subjects can you film in one day?

A well-organised testimonial shoot day can accommodate 4–8 interview subjects, depending on interview length and travel between subjects. For conferences and exhibitions where multiple clients are gathered in a single venue, Backyard Studio regularly films 6–10 testimonials in a single day. Interview scheduling, briefing, and setup are all managed by the production team on the day.

How do you help interview subjects feel comfortable on camera?

Backyard Studio's testimonial process includes a pre-interview briefing — a brief written guide for the subject explaining the questions in advance, what to expect on the day, and general advice on speaking to camera. On set, the interview is conducted in a conversational style rather than as a formal performance, and subjects are given multiple takes for key answers. This approach consistently produces more natural and credible testimonial content than directing subjects to "be professional" or "look into the lens."

Can you film testimonials at an event we're sponsoring?

Yes. content:
Short Film & Web Series Production UAE — Pricing & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Short film production in the UAE starts from AED 25,000 for a professionally produced 5–15 minute narrative short film, and web series production starts from AED 40,000 for a 3-episode series with professional cast, multiple UAE locations, and full post-production. Backyard Studio produces short films, web series, scripted drama, and fiction content for streaming platforms, film festival submission, YouTube, and branded entertainment distribution across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain. Written production proposals, DCP delivery for festivals, and Arabic and English language versions are available. Contact Backyard Studio on +971 58 588 2685.

---

What Is Short Film & Web Series Production?

A short film is a scripted, narrative work of fiction (or narrative non-fiction) typically running between 3 and 40 minutes — produced for film festival submission, streaming platform release, YouTube distribution, or as a creative demonstration of a director's or writer's work. In the UAE, the short film landscape has grown substantially alongside the Dubai International Film Festival, the Abu Dhabi Film Festival, and the Gulf's expanding streaming content market. UAE-based short films are increasingly competing in regional and international festival circuits, and brands are using short film format for premium branded entertainment.

A web series is a scripted, episodic narrative produced for digital distribution — YouTube, Shahid, OSN, and independent streaming channels. Web series in the UAE range from 3-minute comedy sketch series to 20-minute-per-episode drama productions targeting Gulf Arab and South Asian expatriate audiences. Backyard Studio produces both short film single works and multi-episode web series, providing the complete production infrastructure — scriptwriting development, casting, crew, locations, and post-production — for UAE-based fiction content.

---

Short Film & Web Series Production Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Format | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Short Film (5–15 min) | 25,000 – 60,000 | Script-to-screen production, professional cast, 2–3 shoot days, UAE locations, full post + colour grade | | Short Film (15–40 min, festival grade) | 60,000 – 120,000 | Extended production, 3–5 shoot days, experienced DoP, festival DCP delivery | | Web Series (3 episodes, 5–10 min each) | 40,000 – 80,000 | 3-episode scripted series, shared shoot days, full edit + colour grade, YouTube/streaming delivery | | Web Series (6 episodes, 10–20 min each) | 80,000 – 150,000 | 6-episode production, multiple locations, professional ensemble cast, broadcast delivery | | Branded Short Film | 35,000 – 80,000 | Brand-funded narrative short — story-led, brand values integrated without advertising conventions | | Drama Pilot | 30,000 – 60,000 | Single pilot episode, professional TV drama production quality, broadcast spec delivery |

---

What's Included in a Short Film Production

Development and pre-production: - Script development and/or script coverage (Backyard Studio works from your script, or the team can assist with script development) - Casting — sourcing professional UAE-based actors from agency and independent networks - Location scouting and permit coordination across UAE emirates - Production design and art direction - Shot list, storyboard, and shooting schedule - Equipment planning: camera package, lenses, lighting, grip, and sound

Production: - Director, DoP (Director of Photography), and full camera crew - Professional lighting and grip team - Sound recordist with professional boom and radio microphone setup - Art department and props - Drone coverage for aerial sequences - Script supervisor and production assistants

Post-production: - Offline edit and picture lock - Colour grade (DaVinci Resolve, broadcast colour standard) - Professional sound design and audio mix - Music supervision and licensed score or original composition - Visual effects and titles - Subtitle creation in Arabic and English - Delivery: digital streaming (H.264/H.265), broadcast (ProRes), DCP for film festival/cinema

---

Types of Content Backyard Studio Produces

Narrative short films: Scripted fiction in any genre — drama, comedy, thriller, social commentary. UAE-based short films frequently draw on the UAE's multicultural environment, expatriate experience, and Gulf Arab identity as source material. Backyard Studio has produced short films exploring UAE themes for regional and international festival circuits.

Comedy and sketch web series: Short-form scripted comedy for YouTube and social media distribution — typically 2–8 minutes per episode, produced with fast turnaround and multi-episode efficiency. Arabic comedy content and South Asian diaspora comedy are among the strongest-performing formats on UAE YouTube channels.

Drama web series: Longer-form episodic drama — 10–25 minutes per episode — targeting streaming platforms (Shahid, OSN+, and YouTube premium) and UAE-based niche audience communities. Backyard Studio has production experience across Gulf Arab, South Asian, and English-language drama formats.

Branded entertainment shorts: Fiction content funded and produced for brands — the story is the primary product, the brand values are integrated organically rather than advertised. Used by forward-thinking UAE brands wanting to build cultural relevance through storytelling rather than conventional advertising.

Drama pilots: Single pilot episode produced to television drama specifications — designed to demonstrate a series concept to UAE broadcasters (Dubai TV, Abu Dhabi TV, MBC) or streaming commissioning editors (Shahid, OSN). Backyard Studio has helped UAE-based writers and producers develop pilot episodes from spec script to broadcast-ready format.

Short documentary hybrids: Narrative non-fiction blending documentary interview with scripted reconstruction — a format common in factual entertainment programming for UAE streaming platforms.

---

Short Film & Web Series Production Across UAE Emirates

Dubai: The UAE's primary filming environment for scripted fiction — the combination of urban architecture, desert proximity, luxury locations, and a diverse multicultural talent pool makes Dubai one of the most location-rich cities in the world for film production. Dubai Film and TV Commission permits cover all commercial Dubai filming. Dubai Studio City provides soundstage facilities when controlled studio environments are required.

Abu Dhabi: Abu Dhabi Film Commission (twofour54) manages Abu Dhabi filming permits and provides significant financial support to productions that meet UAE local content criteria — a route Backyard Studio can advise on. Abu Dhabi's architectural contrast with Dubai, its traditional districts, and its government facility environments add visual variety to multi-location UAE productions.

Sharjah: Sharjah's Arab cultural identity — heritage districts, traditional architecture, and Islamic cultural aesthetic — makes it a distinctive setting for UAE drama and narrative content. Expo Centre Sharjah and the arts districts provide additional contemporary locations.

Ras Al Khaimah and Northern Emirates: Mountain landscapes, coastal settings, and traditional village environments in RAK and Fujairah provide short film productions with visual environments unavailable in Dubai — regularly used for drama sequences requiring rural, wilderness, or heritage UAE settings.

---

Why UAE Filmmakers Choose Backyard Studio

Full fiction production capability: Backyard Studio is not a corporate video company that occasionally shoots narrative content. The studio's production infrastructure — director, DoP, full camera and lighting crew, sound department, art direction, and post-production — is the same infrastructure required for high-quality scripted fiction. The distinction matters for short film productions where a corporate video approach produces results that don't compete at festival level.

UAE permit expertise: Short film productions in the UAE face the same permit requirements as commercial productions — Dubai Film and TV Commission, Abu Dhabi Film Commission, location-specific permits, drone permits. Backyard Studio manages permit applications across all UAE filming locations as a standard part of the production process.

Arabic-language fiction production: Arabic-language scripted fiction — the primary production format for Gulf Arab audiences — requires directors, crew, and actors working in Arabic, not an English-language crew with translation. Backyard Studio produces Arabic-language scripted content with native Arabic-speaking creative leadership.

DCP delivery for film festivals: Festival-submission short films require DCP (Digital Cinema Package) delivery — a specific format requirement that many production companies in the UAE cannot fulfil. Backyard Studio delivers DCP files to international film festival technical specifications, alongside digital streaming versions.

---

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does short film production cost in the UAE?

Short film production in the UAE starts from AED 25,000 for a professionally produced 5–15 minute narrative short with 2–3 shoot days, professional cast, UAE locations, and full post-production. Festival-grade short films (15–40 minutes) with higher production value, extended shooting schedules, and DCP delivery are priced from AED 60,000 to AED 120,000. All Backyard Studio short film quotes are confirmed in writing before production begins.

How much does a web series cost to produce in the UAE?

A 3-episode web series (5–10 minutes per episode) starts from AED 40,000 — sharing crew and setup costs across multiple episodes significantly reduces per-episode production cost compared to shooting individual films. A 6-episode drama series runs AED 80,000–150,000 depending on episode length, cast size, and location complexity.

Do you work from existing scripts or develop original content?

Both. Backyard Studio works from finished scripts provided by the filmmaker or writer. For clients needing script development alongside production, the team can provide script coverage and development feedback as part of the pre-production process. Backyard Studio does not typically develop original IP for short film productions, but can assist UAE-based writers with script-to-production translation.

Can you deliver short films to UAE film festival technical specifications?

Yes. Backyard Studio delivers short films in DCP (Digital Cinema Package) format for film festival and cinema screening submission. The studio's colour grading and sound mixing processes meet the technical standards required for UAE film festival submission (Dubai International Film Festival, Abu Dhabi Film Festival) and international festival circuits. Broadcast ProRes and digital H.264/H.265 formats are also delivered for streaming and online distribution.

Do you produce content in Arabic?

Yes. Backyard Studio produces short films and web series in Arabic, English, and bilingual Arabic + English formats. Arabic-language scripted fiction is produced with Arabic-speaking directors, cast, and crew — not English-language productions translated into Arabic in post. Arabic-language content for Gulf streaming audiences is a specific production expertise at Backyard Studio.

How long does short film production take?

A short film (5–15 minutes) typically takes 8–12 weeks from script to delivery: 2–3 weeks pre-production (casting, locations, permits), 2–3 shoot days over 1–2 weeks, and 4–6 weeks post-production (edit, colour grade, sound mix, VFX, DCP mastering). Web series productions with shared shoot days can be completed in 12–16 weeks for a 3-episode series. Timelines are confirmed in the written production proposal.

---

Backyard Studio produces short films, web series, scripted drama, and branded fiction content across all seven UAE emirates in Arabic and English.

Contact Backyard Studio on +971 58 588 2685.

---

What Is YouTube Series & Show Production?

YouTube series and show production is the professional production of episodic video content for YouTube — structured as a recurring format (a show, a series, a channel programme) rather than a one-off video. In 2026, YouTube remains the world's second-largest search engine, and for UAE businesses and public figures, a well-produced YouTube show is one of the most powerful long-term content assets available. A YouTube series consistently produced over 12–24 months builds search presence, establishes thought leadership, and creates a library of content that drives organic discovery for years.

The production formats within YouTube series production are varied: a weekly talking-head interview show, a documentary-style travel or food series, a brand-funded educational series, a CEO thought-leadership show, a behind-the-scenes business series, or a podcast production filmed for video distribution. Backyard Studio produces all these formats at UAE production studios or on location across the seven emirates.

---

YouTube Series & Show Production Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Format | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Single-host show (per episode) | from 3,500 | Single camera, professional lighting, lapel mic, episode edit, colour grade, thumbnail | | Interview show (per episode) | from 5,000 | Dual camera setup, 2-person interview, professional lighting + audio, episode edit | | Podcast video (per episode) | from 4,000 | Multi-camera podcast setup, 1–3 guests, individual speaker ISO tracks, full edit | | Location-based episode | from 8,000 | On-location shoot, travel, b-roll, narration, full documentary-style episode edit | | Full monthly production package | from 12,000/mo | 4–8 episodes per month, consistent studio setup, batch filming, edit + delivery pipeline | | Branded series (brand-funded show) | 15,000 – 40,000/episode | Premium production value, scripted or structured format, talent + crew, broadcast-quality delivery |

---

What's Included in a YouTube Show Production

Pre-production: - Show format development (if needed) — defining episode structure, segments, and recurring features - Set design for studio-based shows — branded backdrop, lighting setup, furniture - Interview question guide or episode outline for each shoot - Shoot schedule optimised for batch filming efficiency

Production: - Camera crew and director - Professional three-point lighting setup (or location lighting as needed) - Multi-microphone audio — lapel mics for all on-screen talent, directional boom as backup - B-roll filming to support narrated or documentary episodes - Batch filming: 2–8 episodes filmed in a single day to reduce per-episode cost

Post-production: - Individual episode edit - Colour grade and audio levelling - Intro and outro branded motion graphics - Chapter markers and timestamps for YouTube SEO - Subtitles / closed captions (English and Arabic as required) - Thumbnail design - YouTube-optimised delivery (H.264, appropriate resolution and bitrate for the format)

---

Types of YouTube Shows Backyard Studio Produces

Talking-head single-host shows: A single presenter to camera — opinion, advice, educational, or commentary format. The most efficient YouTube format to produce in bulk: a good presenter can batch-film 4–8 episodes in a single day. Common for business owners, coaches, consultants, and subject-matter experts building a personal brand in the UAE market.

Interview shows: A host interviews a different guest each episode — the classic YouTube format for thought-leadership and business content. Backyard Studio sets up a recurring interview production infrastructure at a fixed studio or location, and hosts bring in guests for batch filming days.

Podcast video productions: Audio podcasts filmed for video distribution — increasingly the standard format for UAE podcasts. Multi-camera setup captures all speakers simultaneously with individual ISO audio tracks, producing a professionally edited video podcast episode. Podcast video production starts from AED 4,000 per episode.

Documentary-style YouTube series: Episodic documentary content — travel series, food series, business journey series, UAE heritage series — filmed on location across the UAE. Each episode is a standalone story connected by a series theme. More production-intensive than studio formats but produces the highest-performing YouTube content in terms of watch time and subscriber retention.

Behind-the-scenes business series: A series documenting the inner workings of a business — production processes, team culture, client relationships, growth milestones. Particularly effective for UAE manufacturers, hospitality groups, and premium service businesses where showing the process builds trust and premium positioning.

Educational and tutorial series: Structured educational content — a series of 5–15 minute educational videos on a professional topic. Law firms, financial advisors, medical specialists, and technology companies in the UAE use educational YouTube series to build authority and capture organic search traffic from professional audiences.

---

YouTube Production Across UAE Emirates

Dubai: Studio-based YouTube productions most commonly use Backyard Studio's Dubai production infrastructure. Dubai Media City and Dubai Studio City offer additional studio facility options for larger productions. Location-based YouTube content has access to all of Dubai's varied environments.

Abu Dhabi: On-location YouTube series episodes across Abu Dhabi — business, government, and cultural subjects — are regular Backyard Studio productions. Abu Dhabi-based shows covering UAE policy, finance, or culture benefit significantly from Abu Dhabi location access and institutional contacts.

Northern Emirates (RAK, Fujairah, Sharjah): Travel, food, and lifestyle YouTube series covering the UAE beyond Dubai increasingly feature Northern Emirates episodes — Ras Al Khaimah's adventure tourism and mountain landscapes, Fujairah's east coast diving and coastal culture, and Sharjah's art and heritage scene all provide distinct YouTube episode content unavailable in Dubai.

Batch filming efficiency: The most cost-effective way to produce a consistent YouTube show is to film multiple episodes in a single day — a well-structured batch filming day produces 4–8 episodes from one crew day booking. Backyard Studio designs YouTube production workflows specifically for batch efficiency, so per-episode cost falls significantly at scale.

Consistent production quality: YouTube audience retention is directly affected by production quality. A well-produced show — professional audio, consistent lighting, clean edit — retains viewers through entire episodes. A poorly produced show loses 60% of viewers in the first 30 seconds. Backyard Studio's YouTube production standard is designed for retention, not just visual appearance.

YouTube SEO integration: Backyard Studio's YouTube production delivery includes chapter markers and timestamps formatted for YouTube search optimisation, subtitle files that index keywords for YouTube's crawlers, and thumbnail design guidelines developed with the platform's click-through rate conventions in mind.

Arabic and English bilingual shows: UAE YouTube shows targeting both Arabic-speaking and English-speaking audiences — a dual-audience challenge unique to the UAE market — are produced by Backyard Studio with bilingual host capability, bilingual subtitle files, and culturally appropriate creative approaches for both audience segments.

---

content:
Travel Videography UAE — Pricing, Services & Guide 2026

Quick Answer

Travel videography in the UAE starts from AED 7,500 per day for professional travel video production, and a full multi-day UAE destination film covering several emirates is typically priced from AED 25,000 to AED 60,000 depending on scope. Backyard Studio produces travel films, tourism destination videos, hotel and resort videography, adventure travel content, and lifestyle travel series across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain. Productions include drone aerial cinematography, on-location crew, and full post-production with music licensing and platform-ready delivery. Contact Backyard Studio on +971 58 588 2685 to discuss a travel videography brief.

---

What Is Travel Videography?

Travel videography is the professional filming of destinations, experiences, and journeys — produced for tourism boards, hotels and resorts, travel brands, airlines, adventure tourism operators, lifestyle brands, and independent travel content channels. The output ranges from a 90-second Instagram Reel showcasing a resort's experience to a 10-minute YouTube travel documentary exploring Ras Al Khaimah's Hajar Mountains, to a full-length 30-minute destination film commissioned by a UAE tourism authority.

In the UAE, the travel videography market is particularly active. The country hosts over 20 million international visitors per year across all seven emirates, and the competition for travel content visibility — on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and tourism authority digital channels — is intense. High-quality travel videography is a primary marketing investment for UAE hotels, resorts, tourism operators, and destination management companies. Backyard Studio produces travel video content across the full UAE geography, from urban Dubai to the Northern Emirates' coastlines and mountains.

---

Travel Videography Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Single location shoot day | from 7,500 | Full-day travel shoot, professional crew, General Civil Aviation Authority drone, edit, 1–3 short-form edits | | Resort / Hotel video package | from 15,000 | 1–2 day hotel/resort production, full facilities coverage, aerial drone, hero video + social cuts | | UAE Destination Film (multi-day) | 25,000 – 60,000 | 3–5 shoot days across multiple emirates, aerial + ground footage, narration, 5–15 min edited film | | Travel Reels Series (monthly) | from 8,000/mo | Monthly on-location travel Reels production — 6–12 Reels per month for hotel or tourism client | | Full UAE Travel Documentary | 40,000 – 100,000+ | Extended multi-week production, all 7 emirates, full documentary with voiceover narrative | | Drone-only Aerial Coverage | from 4,500 | Drone day, aerial footage package, UAE location, 1–3 edits |

---

What's Included in a Travel Video Production

Pre-production: - Shot list based on destination brief and intended platform - Location scouting and filming permit coordination (Dubai Tourism, Abu Dhabi DCT, etc.) - General Civil Aviation Authority drone permit applications (3–5 business day processing) - Talent and presenter coordination (if required) - Logistics planning for multi-location shoots across UAE

Production: - Director and camera crew with cinema-grade camera package - drone operator (DJI Inspire or Mavic 3 Cinema depending on resolution requirements) - Wide-angle and telephoto lens coverage for destination variety - Gimbal stabilised ground footage and handheld b-roll - Golden hour and sunset shooting scheduled into the production day

Post-production: - Cinematic colour grade matching destination light and mood - Licensed music (curated travel and lifestyle library tracks) - Narration recording (if included) - Drone and ground footage integrated - Delivery: 16:9 (YouTube/website), 9:16 (Reels/TikTok), 1:1 (Instagram feed) - SRT subtitle file for social and accessibility

---

UAE Travel Videography Locations

The UAE offers extraordinary geographic and visual variety across its seven emirates — a range that no other country of comparable size can match. Backyard Studio has produced travel content across all of these environments:

Dubai: Downtown skyline at dusk from the Dubai Frame; Dubai Creek dhow scenes in Al Seef; the desert south of Dubai at golden hour; JBR beach at sunrise; DIFC's financial district architecture; the spice and gold souks in Deira; Dubai Museum of the Future; Expo City's permanent pavilions.

Abu Dhabi: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque's architecture (permits required and coordinated); the Corniche waterfront at sunrise; Louvre Abu Dhabi's geometric dome and water reflections; Yas Island's entertainment and F1 circuit; Saadiyat Island's pristine beaches; Empty Quarter desert access from the Al Ain direction; Qasr Al Hosn heritage site in central Abu Dhabi.

Ras Al Khaimah: Jebel Jais mountain road and summit — the UAE's highest point at 1,934 metres; the Hajar Mountain rock formations; RAK Old Town heritage area; Al Hamra village and waterfront; Wadi Ghalilah hiking trails; RAK's coastal wetlands and flamingo feeding grounds.

Fujairah: The UAE's east coast — Khor Fakkan's crescent bay; Al Bidyah Mosque, the UAE's oldest mosque; Fujairah Corniche; Khorfakkan container port views; Wadi Wurayah biosphere reserve; Fujairah Fort and Old Town.

Sharjah: Al Noor Mosque on the Khalid Lagoon; Sharjah Art Foundation and Al Mureijah Square; Sharjah Heritage Area; the Blue Souk (Central Market) at sunset; Al Qasba waterway with the Eye of the Emirates.

Ajman and Umm Al Quwain: Traditional dhow-building yards in Ajman; Umm Al Quwain's mangrove waterways (kayak and boat access); historic forts; unspoilt coastal environments free from urban development.

---

Why Travel Brands Choose Backyard Studio

Drone coverage as standard: Aerial cinematography is the defining element of travel videography — destination overviews, resort reveals, and coastline coverage all depend on it. Backyard Studio includes drone operations as standard on travel video shoots, with permits coordinated in advance for all UAE locations. No unlicensed drone use that risks footage confiscation or legal exposure for the brand.

Golden hour and weather discipline: The quality difference between travel footage shot in flat midday light and footage shot during golden hour (the 45 minutes after sunrise and before sunset) is substantial — it is the single largest determinant of whether travel content feels premium or generic. Backyard Studio builds shooting schedules around golden hour by default.

Full UAE coverage in one production partner: Multi-emirate travel productions — covering 3, 5, or all 7 emirates — require a production partner with crew capacity, permit relationships, and logistical experience across the whole UAE. Backyard Studio has produced content in all seven emirates and manages all cross-emirate logistics in-house.

Fast Reels and social turnaround: For hotels and tourism operators running always-on social media content programmes, Backyard Studio's travel Reels production service delivers edited social-ready Reels within 48 hours of the shoot day — keeping the content calendar filled without production delay.

---

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does travel videography cost in the UAE?

Travel videography in the UAE starts from AED 7,500 for a single-day location shoot with professional crew and General Civil Aviation Authority drone. A hotel or resort video package covering 1–2 days and producing a hero video plus social content starts from AED 15,000. A multi-day UAE destination film covering several emirates is priced from AED 25,000 to AED 60,000. Full UAE travel documentary productions start from AED 40,000.

Does travel videography in the UAE include drone footage?

Yes. Drone operations are included as standard in Backyard Studio's travel video packages. Aerial work is fully permitted, and permit applications for UAE aerial filming locations are coordinated by the production team before the shoot. Drone-only coverage packages (without a full ground crew) are also available from AED 4,500 per day.

Can you cover all seven UAE emirates in one production?

Yes. Backyard Studio has produced travel content across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain — and regularly coordinates multi-emirate productions with 3–7 shooting days. All logistics, permits, and crew coordination across emirate borders are managed by Backyard Studio's production team.

Do you produce travel content for hotels and resorts?

Yes. Hotel and resort video production is one of Backyard Studio's primary travel videography formats. Productions typically cover: hero video showcasing the full property and guest experience; room and suite tours; F&B coverage (restaurant and bar experiences); pool and beach/leisure areas; spa and wellness; aerial overview showing the property's location and surroundings. Social Reels packages for monthly property content marketing are available on retainer.

Can you produce travel content for social media creators?

Yes. Backyard Studio supports UAE-based and visiting travel content creators with production services — from single-day crew hire to fully managed production days including location planning, permits, and editing. Creator travel content packages are available from AED 7,500 per day.

What permits are needed for travel filming in the UAE?

Permits for travel and tourism filming in Dubai are issued by Dubai Tourism (Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism). Abu Dhabi filming is coordinated through the Department of Culture and Tourism (DCT Abu Dhabi). Individual location permits (hotels, attractions, government sites) require separate applications. Drone filming across the UAE requires General Civil Aviation Authority permits regardless of location — processing typically takes 3–5 business days. Backyard Studio manages all permit applications as part of the travel video production process.

---

content:
Drama Production UAE — TV Drama, Digital Series & Scripted Content 2026

Quick Answer

Drama production in the UAE starts from AED 30,000 per episode for a digital drama series produced to broadcast-quality standards, and rises to AED 80,000 and above per episode for full television drama with professional ensemble casts, multi-location shoots, and broadcast delivery to UAE and regional satellite channels. Backyard Studio produces TV drama, digital drama series, scripted Arabic and English content, Ramadan drama, and branded narrative content across all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain. Productions are delivered to broadcast specifications for UAE TV channels (Dubai TV, Abu Dhabi TV, MBC) and streaming platforms (Shahid, OSN+, YouTube Premium). Contact Backyard Studio on +971 58 588 2685.

---

What Is Drama Production?

Drama production is the scripted, fictional filmmaking category — narrative content with actors performing written characters and scenes, as distinct from documentary, news, or unscripted entertainment. In the UAE and Gulf region, drama production has a distinct professional identity: the annual Ramadan drama season is the Arab world's most-watched television event, Gulf-produced digital drama for YouTube and Shahid reaches hundreds of millions of views, and South Asian diaspora drama channels in the UAE serve a combined audience of over 3 million South Asian expatriates.

Backyard Studio produces drama content across multiple formats: single-episode pilots developed for broadcaster pitching; short-form digital drama series for YouTube and streaming platforms; branded drama series funded by UAE corporations; and Ramadan drama content produced for annual seasonal distribution. Arabic-language drama production is a core capability, with Arabic-speaking directors, writers, and professional acting talent.

---

Drama Production Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Format | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Drama Pilot (single episode) | 30,000 – 60,000 | Full scripted production, professional cast, 2–3 shoot days, broadcast-quality post | | Digital Drama Series (10–15 min/episode) | 30,000 – 50,000/ep | Per-episode digital drama, shared crew and setup, streaming delivery | | TV Drama Series (30–45 min/episode) | 60,000 – 120,000/ep | Full broadcast drama production, professional ensemble cast, multi-location, broadcast delivery | | Ramadan Drama (30 × 30 min episodes) | from 800,000 | Full Ramadan series — scripted, produced and delivered to broadcast spec for the Ramadan period | | Branded Drama (5–8 episodes) | 150,000 – 400,000 | Brand-funded narrative drama, series development + full production, Arabic or English | | Short-form Drama (3–5 min/episode) | 8,000 – 20,000/ep | Short scripted narrative, 2–3 actors, 1 location per episode, social platform delivery |

---

What's Included in a Drama Production

Development and pre-production: - Script breakdown and production scheduling - Casting: professional audition process, UAEbased actors from agency networks and independent talent - Location scouting and permit coordination across UAE (Dubai Film and TV Commission, Abu Dhabi Film Commission) - Production design: set design, props, wardrobe department - Blocking rehearsal with director and lead cast - Equipment planning: camera package, lighting, grip, sound

Production: - Director with scripted fiction experience - DoP (Director of Photography) and full camera crew - Professional lighting and grip department - Sound recordist, boom operator, production sound mixer - Art department (set decorator, props, continuity) - Wardrobe department - 1st and 2nd assistant directors, production assistants - Script supervisor

Post-production: - Assembly edit and fine cut - Colour grade to broadcast standard (Rec.709 or HDR as required) - Sound design and foley - Professional audio mix (dialogue, music, effects) - Music supervision: licensed library or original score - VFX and compositing where required - Subtitles and closed captions (Arabic, English) - Broadcast delivery: ProRes 4444 or H.265 to UAE channel specifications

---

Types of Drama Content Backyard Studio Produces

Ramadan drama series: The most significant drama production window in the UAE and Arab world — 30-episode serialised drama broadcast daily through the Ramadan month across MBC, Dubai TV, and Abu Dhabi TV. Backyard Studio provides production services for Ramadan drama productions — from full series production to specific production services (locations, crew, post-production) for established drama producers.

Digital drama series: Episodic scripted drama produced for YouTube, Shahid, and OSN+ — typically 10–25 minutes per episode, 6–13 episodes per series. Digital drama in the Gulf region has produced some of the highest-viewed Arabic drama content on YouTube, attracting audiences far beyond the traditional satellite TV drama viewer. Backyard Studio produces digital drama for Arabic-language, South Asian, and English-language audience segments.

Branded drama: Corporations and brands fund scripted drama as a premium long-form marketing vehicle — the narrative integrates brand values and product placement organically, without conventional advertising interruption. Branded drama is common in the UAE among telecommunications companies, automotive brands, and fast-moving consumer goods brands that want to build cultural presence over a Ramadan or seasonal campaign period.

Comedy drama (sitcom and dramedy): Short-form scripted comedy-drama — a format with a large UAE YouTube audience. Culturally specific comedy addressing UAE expatriate life, Gulf Arab social dynamics, or multicultural workplace situations performs strongly in the UAE market. Backyard Studio has produced comedy drama in Arabic, English, and Urdu/Hindi for specific diaspora audience channels.

Social issue drama: Scripted drama tackling social themes relevant to the UAE — produced for NGOs, government communications campaigns, or independent distribution. Subject to UAE content regulations, social issue drama is a meaningful format for organisations communicating public health, environmental, or community messages through narrative rather than information campaigns.

---

Drama Production Across UAE Emirates

Dubai: Dubai is the UAE's primary drama production centre — Dubai Studio City provides sound stage facilities; Dubai Media City provides connectivity to broadcaster partners and post-production houses; diverse Dubai locations (heritage areas, modern commercial, desert) provide wide visual range for drama production without the logistical complexity of multi-emirate shoots.

Abu Dhabi: Abu Dhabi Film Commission (twofour54) actively supports drama production in Abu Dhabi, including cash rebate programmes for qualifying productions. Abu Dhabi's government buildings, cultural institutions, and desert access provide locations unavailable in Dubai, and the emirate's political significance makes it the natural setting for drama exploring UAE national themes.

Sharjah: Sharjah's heritage and cultural character — the Al Hisn Fort, Heritage Area, and Islamic architecture — provides the UAE's richest environment for historical and traditional drama settings. Sharjah-set drama exploring Gulf Arab cultural themes has an authentic location advantage not replicable in Dubai.

Northern Emirates: Ras Al Khaimah's mountain landscapes, traditional villages, and heritage fortifications; Fujairah's east coast fishing communities; Ajman's dhow-building yards — all locations that provide UAE drama with geographic and cultural range beyond the urban commercial setting of Dubai.

---

Why Productions Choose Backyard Studio for Drama

Arabic-language drama capability: Gulf Arabic drama requires directors, writers, actors, and crew who understand the specific cultural conventions, dialectal nuance, and production traditions of Gulf Arab drama. Backyard Studio's drama production team includes Arabic-speaking creative leadership and connections to the UAE's professional Arabic-speaking acting talent.

Broadcast delivery expertise: Drama produced for UAE television channels must meet specific broadcast technical specifications — colour space, audio loudness, file format, and captioning requirements. Backyard Studio's post-production team is familiar with the technical delivery requirements of Dubai TV, Abu Dhabi TV, and the MBC Group, and has experience in the QC (quality control) process for UAE broadcaster delivery.

UAE filming permit management: Drama productions require more extensive permit management than commercial or documentary productions — multiple locations, extended shooting periods, government site access, and crowd control permits all require advance coordination. Backyard Studio manages the full permit process through Dubai Film and TV Commission and Abu Dhabi Film Commission for drama productions across the UAE.

Full production infrastructure: A drama production requires a substantially larger crew than corporate or commercial video — script supervisor, art department, costume department, multiple camera assistants, and experienced production assistants are all essential for efficient drama filming. Backyard Studio can resource and crew drama productions from its UAE-based crew network.

---

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does drama production cost in the UAE?

Drama production in the UAE is priced by format and scope. A digital drama series episode (10–15 minutes) starts from AED 30,000 per episode for professional production with cast, crew, UAE locations, and broadcast-quality post-production. A full television drama episode (30–45 minutes) suitable for satellite broadcast starts from AED 60,000 per episode. Ramadan drama series (30 × 30 minute episodes) are budgeted from AED 800,000 for the full series.

Do you produce Arabic drama?

Yes. Arabic-language drama production is a core capability at Backyard Studio. Productions are developed with Arabic-speaking creative directors, Arabic scriptwriting support, professional Arabic-speaking actors from UAE and Gulf-wide talent networks, and delivery to Arabic-language broadcaster specifications. Gulf Arabic dialect content for UAE national audiences and Modern Standard Arabic content for pan-Arab broadcast distribution are both produced.

Can you produce Ramadan drama content?

Yes. Ramadan drama is the largest single production window in the UAE and Arab world. Backyard Studio provides production services for Ramadan drama — from full series production to specific production elements (UAE locations, post-production, casting coordination) for existing productions. Ramadan drama productions must be planned 6–10 months in advance for the preceding Ramadan period. Contact Backyard Studio to discuss Ramadan production timelines.

Do you produce South Asian drama for UAE audiences?

Yes. The UAE hosts over 3 million South Asian expatriates, and Urdu-language, Hindi-language, and South Asian English drama has a large and commercially significant audience in the UAE. Backyard Studio has produced content for South Asian UAE audience channels and can resource South Asian acting talent and crew in the UAE market.

What UAE TV channels can you deliver to?

Backyard Studio delivers drama content to the broadcast technical specifications of Dubai TV, Abu Dhabi TV, MBC Group channels, Sharjah TV, and regional pan-Arab satellite channels. Digital streaming delivery to Shahid, OSN+, and YouTube is also handled in standard deliverables. All technical specifications for each channel or platform are confirmed in the production proposal before filming begins.

Can you help develop a drama concept into a broadcast-ready pitch?

Yes. Backyard Studio can assist UAE-based writers and producers in developing a drama concept from treatment through pilot episode — the standard format for pitching to UAE broadcasters and streaming commissioning editors. A pilot episode produced to broadcast quality, alongside a series bible and treatment document, is the professional standard for drama pitch submissions.

---

content:
Brand Profile Revamp & Individual Video Portfolio UAE — Pricing 2026

Quick Answer

Individual video portfolio production and brand profile revamp content in the UAE starts from AED 5,000 for a professional personal brand video and rises to AED 25,000 and above for a full brand identity refresh production including hero video, social content suite, and photography. Backyard Studio creates individual video portfolios, personal brand films, executive profile videos, professional athlete profiles, and brand refresh content for individuals and businesses repositioning in the UAE market. Productions cover all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain. Contact Backyard Studio on +971 58 588 2685.

---

What Is a Profile Revamp & Individual Video Portfolio?

A profile revamp is a professional video production specifically designed to update, refresh, and reposition an individual's or brand's visual presence and public identity — used when a person or company has grown, changed direction, or entered a new market and needs content that reflects who they are now rather than who they were when their existing content was produced.

An individual video portfolio is a curated collection of professionally produced video content documenting an individual's skills, achievements, experience, and professional identity — used by athletes, performing artists, executives, academics, consultants, architects, and creative professionals to present their work credibly to employers, clients, agents, competition committees, and media.

In the UAE, where professional reputation is heavily driven by digital presence — LinkedIn, personal websites, and Google search results — a professional video portfolio or brand refresh is an investment in first impressions at scale. A polished 90-second personal brand video on LinkedIn or a well-produced portfolio page on a personal website reaches more professional opportunities than any number of written profiles.

---

Profile Revamp & Video Portfolio Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Personal Brand Video (60–90 sec) | from 5,000 | Half-day shoot, 1 location, professional lighting, edit + colour grade, social format delivery | | Executive Profile Video | from 8,000 | Interview + b-roll at workspace/location, professional lighting + audio, 2–4 min profile video | | Individual Achievement Portfolio (3–8 min) | 12,000 – 25,000 | Full individual profile — interview, location coverage, achievement showcase, documentary style | | Athlete Video Portfolio | 10,000 – 20,000 | Training footage + interview + highlight compilation, multi-location, social reel + full portfolio version | | Brand Profile Revamp (full package) | 20,000 – 45,000 | New hero video + social content suite + photography — complete visual identity refresh | | Performing Artist Portfolio | 8,000 – 18,000 | Performance footage + interview + achievement profile — music, dance, theatre, comedy |

---

What's Included in an Individual Video Portfolio Production

Pre-production: - Portfolio strategy consultation — identifying the target audience, platform, and professional objective of the portfolio - Shot list based on skills, achievements, and environments to showcase - Location selection — office, training facility, studio, outdoor, or combination - Styling and wardrobe guidance - Interview question framework based on the individual's story and objectives

Production: - Professional camera crew with cinema-grade camera - Professional three-point lighting setup - Lapel microphone and directional audio - B-roll: workplace, training, skills in action, location context - Interview — structured and conversational, with multiple takes for natural delivery

Post-production: - Full portfolio video edit (2–8 minutes) - Short-form social version (60–90 seconds for LinkedIn and Instagram) - Colour grade - Branded lower thirds with name, title, and credentials - Music bed (licensed) - Subtitle file (English and/or Arabic) - Multi-format delivery: 16:9 (website/YouTube), 9:16 (social), 1:1 (LinkedIn)

---

Types of Profile & Portfolio Content Backyard Studio Creates

Personal brand videos: A concise 60–90 second video that introduces an individual to their professional network — who they are, what they do, who they help, and what makes them distinctive. The most widely used format for LinkedIn profile videos, speaker bureau pages, and personal website hero content. Used by executives, consultants, coaches, entrepreneurs, and any individual whose work depends on personal credibility and relationship trust.

Executive profile videos: A more detailed (2–4 minute) profile of a senior executive — combining interview with workspace and work-in-action b-roll. Used for company "About the Team" pages, keynote speaker profiles, board appointment announcements, award nomination submissions, and business publication profiles.

Individual achievement portfolios: A documentary-style video profile (3–8 minutes) documenting an individual's career achievements — most commonly produced for senior professionals transitioning between sectors, entrepreneurs announcing a new venture, and individuals seeking board or advisory appointments. The format mirrors a documentary short: structured interview, archival stills and video where relevant, and b-roll illustrating the individual's environment and work.

Athlete video portfolios: Professional video portfolios for UAE-based and visiting athletes — combining training footage, competition highlights, coach or team testimony, and an athlete interview. Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a personal brand video cost in the UAE?

Personal brand video production in the UAE starts from AED 5,000 for a 60–90 second professional brand video with half-day production, one location, professional lighting and audio, edit, colour grade, and social format delivery. Executive profile videos (2–4 minutes) start from AED 8,000. A full individual achievement portfolio documentary (3–8 minutes) is priced from AED 12,000 to AED 25,000.

What is a brand profile revamp and when do I need one?

A brand profile revamp is a comprehensive update of a business's video and photography presence — new hero video, new social content suite, and updated brand photography — produced in a coordinated production to ensure visual consistency across all platforms. You likely need a brand revamp if: your existing video content is more than 2 years old, your company has significantly grown or changed services, you're entering a new market, or your leadership team has changed. Backyard Studio's brand profile revamp packages start from AED 20,000.

Can you produce an athlete video portfolio in the UAE?

Yes. Backyard Studio produces professional athlete video portfolios for UAE-based and visiting athletes across all sports — football, cricket, MMA, swimming, equestrian, golf, basketball, and others. A standard athlete portfolio production (training footage + competition highlights + interview) is priced from AED 10,000 and includes social reel cuts (60–90 seconds for Instagram) and a full portfolio version (3–5 minutes) for agency and sponsorship submissions.

Do you produce portfolio videos for performing artists?

Yes. Musicians, dancers, actors, and performing artists working in the UAE commission video portfolios for agency applications, festival submissions, and media coverage. Backyard Studio produces performing artist portfolio videos that combine performance footage (live or specially filmed) with an artist interview. Productions are priced from AED 8,000 and delivered in formats suitable for YouTube, Instagram, agent submission packages, and festival digital programmes.

How long does a personal brand video take to produce?

A personal brand video (60–90 seconds) takes 1–2 weeks from brief to delivery: pre-production consultation and shot planning (3–5 days), half-day shoot, and 3–5 days post-production. An executive profile video or full portfolio documentary takes 2–4 weeks depending on complexity and locations. Rush timelines are available for award submissions and time-sensitive professional milestones.

Can you update my brand video to reflect a new service or company direction?

Yes. Backyard Studio produces brand refresh productions for companies whose existing video content no longer accurately represents them. A targeted brand refresh — re-filming specific sections of an existing company video to reflect new services, a new team, or a new market position — is often more cost-effective than a full re-production. Backyard Studio reviews existing content before recommending a full revamp or a targeted update.

Do you produce individual video portfolios in Arabic?

Yes. Individual video portfolios and personal brand content in Arabic — for UAE national professionals presenting to Arabic-language professional networks, government bodies, or Gulf Arab business environments — are produced with Arabic-speaking directors and delivered with Arabic subtitles and captions. Arabic-language LinkedIn content for UAE national professionals significantly outperforms English-language equivalents in terms of professional network engagement.
